title: Client Advisor / Crisis Response Coordinator (US Hours) (MALE)
description:
We are hiring 3 Client Advisors / Crisis Response Coordinators to join our remote team. (Please send a 60-second English voice recording introducing yourself, explaining why you are a strong fit, and summarizing your phone-based sales or client support experience.)



This role has a sales component, but it is not an aggressive sales role. You will not be pushing a product to random leads. Your job is to respond quickly to inbound inquiries, calm the client when needed, understand the urgency of the case, explain how the service works, recommend the right service package, and guide the client through agreement, payment, onboarding, and handoff to our operations team.



We are looking for candidates with a mature, steady, confident phone presence. The right person should sound calm under pressure, communicate clearly with US-based clients, and handle sensitive conversations professionally.



What You’ll Do

- Respond to inbound leads through phone, SMS, WhatsApp,
, and messaging platforms within minutes.

- Conduct first consultations by listening to the client’s situation, assessing urgency, and recommending the most suitable service package.

- Explain the services, pricing, onboarding steps, contracts, and expectations clearly.

- Guide clients through the agreement, payment, and onboarding process.

- Coordinate with the operations team after the client signs up to ensure a smooth case handoff.

- Follow up with clients at key milestones, including after 24 hours, weekly updates, and service completion.

- Maintain accurate records in our dashboard, including lead status, call notes, messages, contracts, and follow-up tasks.

- Collect client feedback and reviews after successful service completion.

- Work reliably during your assigned shift to ensure fast response coverage.



What We’re Looking For

- At least 2 years of phone-based sales, customer service, client consultation, call center, or account support experience.

- Clear spoken English and the ability to communicate confidently with US-based clients.

- Calm, mature, and professional phone manner.

- Strong empathy and emotional control when speaking with distressed clients.

- Ability to guide a conversation without sounding pushy or aggressive.

- Experience handling objections, pricing conversations, and follow-ups.

- Strong reliability. Late starts and no-shows directly affect client response times.

- Fast and stable internet connection.

- Quiet workspace suitable for professional calls.

- Own computer, headset, and microphone.

- Comfortable using CRM, dashboard, messaging, and calling tools.



Nice to Have

- Experience in legal services, insurance, cybersecurity, financial services, healthcare support, emergency support, trust and safety, or crisis-related customer service.

- Previous experience working with US-based clients.

- Inbound sales, client advisory, retention, or customer success background.

- Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Notion, GoHighLevel, Slack, WhatsApp Business, Aircall, RingCentral, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

- Experience in sensitive client conversations where confidentiality, trust, and clear communication are important.



Priority Shift Schedule

- We are currently hiring for Shift A and Shift C.

| Shift   |    US Eastern Time |  Manila Time |

| Shift A |  8:00 AM – 4:00 PM |  8:00 PM – 4:00 AM |

| Shift C | 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM | 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM |



Compensation & Growth

- Base salary: $800/month

- Commission: 3%–10% on closed deals, depending on monthly performance and collected revenue.

- Additional performance incentives may include:

- Client review bonus and more.



Top performers may be promoted to Senior Client Advisor / Team Lead, with base salary increase and additional training responsibilities.



Employee Benefits:

- Monthly base salary + tiered commission (3-5% of revenue)                                                       

- $10 bonus per verified customer review  

- $300 retention bonus every 3 months of tenure                                                                   

- 13th month pay (1× base salary, paid by Dec 20 — soft-conditional on hitting average commission performance)                                                                      

- 10 days paid annual leave per year

- 3 days paid sick leave per year (no doctor's note required)                                                     

- 2× pay if you work on PH regular public holidays 

- Full Sunday off — guaranteed weekly rest day



Hiring Process:

- Application review.

- Resume/CV and voice recording review.

- Written screening assessment.

- Live interview with scenario-based questions.

- Mock consultation role-play.

- Reference/profile check.

- Offer, NDA, agreement, and onboarding.

title: SENIOR MEDIA BUYER — META & GOOGLE ADS (ECOM / DTC)
description:
We are looking for a Senior Media Buyer with deep, proven experience scaling eCommerce and DTC brands on Meta and Google Ads.



This is NOT an entry-level or “boost the post” role. We run real budgets and we scale. We need someone who already thinks the modern way about paid media, not someone still managing campaigns the way it was done five years ago.



Who we are looking for



You understand that on today’s Meta, the creative is the main lever, the algorithm finds the audience, and your job is to feed it strong signal and read the account like a diagnostician, not to micro-manage interests and audiences all day. If you still build accounts with dozens of interest-based ad sets and adjust budgets every hour, this role is not for you.



You read an account top-down: offer, creative, landing page, then media account. You know that a campaign with spend and no sales is usually not an “audience problem.” You let the algorithm learn instead of strangling it. You scale with judgment, not panic.



Responsibilities



 • Plan, launch, and scale Meta and Google campaigns for our DTC brands

 • Build account structures that give the algorithm clean signal

 • Work hand in hand with our Creative Strategists, because creative is the lever

 • Diagnose underperformance by layer (offer, creative, page, account), not by reflex

 • Manage real budgets with discipline and clear reporting

 • Scale winners horizontally and vertically without killing the learning phase

 • Own your numbers: CPA, ROAS, contribution, payback



Requirements



 • Extensive, proven experience scaling eCommerce / DTC brands on Meta Ads

Not just for a few weeks.

Not just for random projects.

We’re building a real long-term operation with people that want stability, growth, and a strong team around them.

A lot of our best people started in smaller roles and worked themselves up over time through consistency, quality, and reliability.



What You’ll Actually Do

You will build and localize ecommerce funnels for different European markets like:



• Sweden

• Germany

• Netherlands / Belgium

• Israel

• Poland

• Norway



You’ll work inside:

• Funnelish

• Shopify

• Wetracked integrations

• Our internal systems and templates



This is NOT about designing from scratch all day.

It’s about:



• following proven structures

• adapting funnels correctly, understanding what and when to add things to our template

• Work with Snapping tool and our Claude.ai html output machine

• Work with gemini, chatgpt pro and magnific on image generations instead of manual editing

• editing graphics/images when needed

• making sure names, prices, bundles, offers and layouts are perfect

• understanding how the backend connects together

Attention to detail matters a lot here.



You Don’t Need To Know Everything

We will teach:

• better AI workflows

• image upscaling/editing methods

• localization systems

• optimization tricks

• our funnel standards

But you MUST:

• learn fast

• care about quality

• communicate clearly

• double-check your work



Team Culture

We are not a freelancer marketplace.



We have:

• departments

• team structure

• support systems

• weekly calls

• long-term growth opportunities

We want people who enjoy being part of a team and improving over time.



Compensation & Growth

• Starting pay: around $5/hour

• Strong performers can grow to $6–6.5/hour+

• Paid sprint challenges

• Bonus opportunities

• Stable full-time workload

• Long-term security for reliable tea
mbers

For many people in our team, this became a stable long-term income source.



We’re Probably A Good Fit If You:

• already built funnels before, undertsand html a bit, you rarely do mistakes and adjust fully to our workflows.

• understand Shopify basics

• know how to work carefully

• can follow templates and systems

• enjoy structured work

• want stable long-term work instead of random clients



 To Apply Send:





Funnel examples you built (latest links)





Your experience with Funnelish / Shopify





AI tools you use





Your average funnel build time





Why you want a long-term role





We care much more about reliability and consistency than ego.

If your work is clean and you’re dependable, you’ll fit in well here.

title: Position: Amazon Online Arbitrage Trainer (Cebu, Philippines)
description:
Position: Amazon Online Arbitrage Trainer (Cebu, Philippines)



I am looking for an experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) and Retail Arbitrage (RA) specialist based in Cebu, Philippines to provide in-person training and mentorship to a family member who is learning to be my VA.



IMPORTANT:

This is NOT a private label position.

This is NOT a PPC position.

This is NOT a listing creation position.



I am specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience sourcing profitable products for resale on Amazon, and able to teach Amazon back end.



Requirements:



* Must currently live in Cebu and be available for occasional in-person meetings.

* Experience with Online Arbitrage and/or Retail Arbitrage.

* Experience using Keepa and SellerAmp.

* Strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central.

* Experience evaluating product profitability, sales rank, competition, and risks.

* Good communication and teaching skills.

* Patient with beginners.



Training Topics:



* Product sourcing and deal analysis.

* Keepa chart interpretation.

* SellerAmp usage.

* Amazon restrictions and risk management.

* Profit calculations.

* Inventory management.

* FBA shipment creation.

* Daily Amazon seller workflows.



This role is focused on training and mentorship rather than managing an Amazon account.



When applying, please include:



1. Years of OA/RA experience.

2. Average number of products sourced per week.

3. Tools used (Keepa, SellerAmp, etc.).

4. Experience training others.

5. Hourly rate.

6. Location within Cebu.

7. Brief explanation of your sourcing process.



Preference will be given to applicants with proven OA/RA sourcing experience rather than private label, PPC, or listing optimization backgrounds.

title: Dental Marketing Specialist
description:
About Us

We are a growing group of dental practices based in Ireland, operating multiple clinics with further expansion underway. We already work with a marketing company that runs much of our advertising — what we need now is someone in-house to own the daily picture: are leads coming in, are the campaigns actually performing, are those leads being contacted fast enough, and where are we leaking money or opportunities. You'll be the person who keeps everyone honest and the system tight.

What You'll Be Doing



Reviewing incoming leads every working day across all clinics and campaigns

Monitoring campaign performance (Meta & Google Ads) — spotting drops, spikes, attribution gaps, and wasted spend, and flagging them quickly

Tracking speed-to-lead: making sure every lead is contacted within target time, and surfacing the ones that slip through

Holding both the marketing company and the clinic teams accountable to the numbers — clear daily/weekly reporting on leads, cost-per-lead, contact rates, and conversions

Building and maintaining automations — lead routing, follow-up sequences, alerts for uncontacted leads, reminders, and reporting dashboards

Keeping lead data clean and consistent across the CRM and clinic systems

Liaising with our external marketing company — interrogating their reports rather than taking them at face value

Identifying patterns: which campaigns, locations, and treatments produce the best leads and the best conversions



What We Need From You



Demonstrable experience in the dental industry (or, at minimum, healthcare/clinical/multi-site services) — you understand the patient journey from enquiry to booked appointment

Solid working knowledge of Meta Ads and Google Ads — enough to read performance data critically, spot problems, and challenge an agency, even if you're not the one building campaigns from scratch

Hands-on experience setting up automations — [e.g. Zapier, Make, GoHighLevel, n8n — confirm your tools]

Strong analytical skills — comfortable living in spreadsheets, dashboards, and lead reports

A sharp eye for detail and a "follow the lead until it's resolved" mentality

Excellent written English and clear, proactive daily communication

Reliable computer and stable internet connection



Nice to Have



Experience with CRM and lead-management systems

Familiarity with dental practice management software (e.g. Aerona, Dentally)

Experience working alongside or managing an external marketing agency

GA4, call-tracking, and UTM/attribution experience

Experience across multiple locations/accounts simultaneously



How to Apply

Please reply with:



A short note on your specific experience in the dental or healthcare sector

The lead/campaign metrics you've tracked before, and the tools you used

An example of an automation you've built (what problem it solved)

Your availability and expected monthly rate



To confirm you've read this in full, start your application with the word "ENAMEL". Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Qualified Accountant — Dental Group (Ireland) | Management Accounts, Cashflow & Bank Reporting
description:
We are a growing group of dental practices based in Ireland, currently operating multiple clinics with further expansion underway. As we scale, we need a sharp, reliable, fully qualified accountant to take ownership of our day-to-day finance function and management reporting. You'll work directly with the operations and finance leadership and become a trusted part of a fast-moving team.

What You'll Be Doing



Processing supplier invoices and maintaining accurate purchase/sales ledgers

Reconciling bank statements across multiple clinic accounts

Preparing monthly management accounts (P&L, balance sheet, variance commentary)

Building and maintaining cashflow statements and forward cashflow forecasts

Producing financial projections and budgets to support business planning and new clinic openings

Preparing financial packs and submissions for our banks (facility applications, funding reviews, periodic reporting)

Supporting month-end and year-end close, and liaising with our external accountants/auditors as needed



What We Need From You



Fully qualified accountant (CPA, ACCA, or equivalent)

Demonstrable experience working in or for the dental industry (or, at minimum, multi-site healthcare/clinical practices) — you understand associate payments, lab costs, treatment-fee structures, and clinic cost lines

Strong hands-on experience with cloud accounting software — [e.g. Xero / Sage / QuickBooks — confirm your stack]

Confident building cashflows and projections in Excel/Google Sheets, not just reporting on history

Excellent written English and clear, proactive communication

Accuracy, discretion, and the ability to own a task end-to-end without hand-holding

Reliable computer and stable internet connection



Nice to Have



Experience preparing bank/funding submissions

Familiarity with Irish accounting or VAT (training given — but a plus)

Exposure to dental practice management software (e.g. Aerona, Dentally)



How to Apply

Please reply with:



A short note on your specific experience in the dental or healthcare sector

Your accounting qualification and year obtained

The accounting software you're strongest in

Your availability and expected monthly rate



To confirm you've read this in full, start your application with the word "MOLAR". Applications without it will not be reviewed.



A couple of things to confirm before you post:



Accounting software — I've put Xero/Sage/QuickBooks as a placeholder. Tell me your actual stack and I'll tighten that line.

Dental experience — I framed it as a hard requirement with a healthcare fallback. Genuine dental-sector experience is rare on OnlineJobs.ph, so keeping the fallback widens your pool meaningfully. Want me to make it strictly dental-only instead?

Rate/hours — left blank for you to drop in.

title: AI UGC Short-Form Video Editor (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We run a short-form content operation. We turn content briefs into vertical short videos in the UGC style using AI tools (AI avatar + AI voiceover + editing). We are hiring editors for a long-term, full-time role, not a one-off gig. Strong editors here make hundreds of videos with us over the coming months. BUT performance is in your hands, with our guidance.



This is editing work. You take a brief and a proven reference video, then produce finished short videos. You do not post anything and you do not need to be on camera. You make the file, we handle distribution.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Produce finished vertical short videos (9:16, about 30 to 45 seconds, captioned, to spec)

- Start from a brief and a reference video we give you, and adapt the proven format (we teach you a simple checklist to validate an idea before you build it)

- Work at real volume: about 6 finished videos per day once ramped (about 180 per month)

- Send your work in the chat every day for quick feedback and act on it fast



TOOLS (we provide the accounts and credits)

- AI avatar / video: HeyGen or Kling

- AI voice: ElevenLabs

- Editing: CapCut, Premiere, or similar



WHAT WE LOOK FOR (this matters more than a fancy reel)

- Taste: the video can look rough, but it needs a strong hook and the right feel. We hire for instinct, not polish.

- Coachability: we give blunt, one-line feedback all day. The editors who win take it well and fix it fast.

- Reliability: you hit your daily count and communicate without being chased.



PAY AND GROWTH

- Paid trial first (3 to 5 videos at full rate; we never ask for free work), then a full-time monthly salary for the editors we keep.

- Virality bonuses when a video pops.

- Long-term partnership. We invest in editors who stick and improve.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully)

1. Put the word "PIXEL" at the top of your application so we know you read this. Applications without it will NOT be reviewed.

2. Include a link to ONE short-form video you made. It can be rough, but it must be made by you, not a repurposed old clip. No video = not reviewed.

3. Tell us: the AI video and voice tools you use, the niches or styles you have made the most content for, how many finished short videos you can make per day, and your timezone and weekly hours.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor Needed - Footwear Brand (Paid Per Video)



Pay: $25-30 USD per video

Type: Freelance / Per-project, ongoing work for the right fit

Niche: Footwear / Comfort & Orthopedic Shoes (US market)





About the Role



We're a growing footwear brand looking for a skilled video editor to create high-converting VSL-style and UGC-style ads. You'll be working with a mix of content we provide and content you source yourself.



This is an ongoing opportunity - after a short test edit.





What You'll Be Editing





VSL-style videos - structured, persuasive video sales letters highlighting product benefits

UGC-style ads - native, authentic-feeling content with heavy use of B-roll

A mix of both styles depending on the assignment







What We Provide





Some raw footage and product content

Brand guidelines, messaging, and direction per assignment

Reference examples for style and pacing







What We Expect From You





You're comfortable sourcing additional B-roll content yourself via Pinterest and/or TikTok when needed to fill out a video

Strong sense of pacing, hooks, and retention for short-form and VSL formats

Experience editing for paid social ads (Meta/TikTok) is a big plus

Reliable communication and ability to turn around videos within agreed deadlines







How to Apply





Send us your portfolio or examples of previous video editing work (UGC and/or VSL style preferred)

If selected, you'll complete a short test edit (30-45 seconds) based on a sample brief - just the hook and problem section, so it's a small time investment

Based on the test, you'll be added to our rotation and receive assignments going forward







Pay Structure





$25-30 USD per video, depending on complexity

Short test edit (30-45 seconds), if approved, your first full video becomes your first paid assignment

Ongoing work for editors who deliver consistent quality







If you're someone who understands what makes short-form video stop the scroll and can bring your own creative eye to sourcing B-roll, we'd love to see your work.

title: VIDEO EDITOR / AI CREATOR (ECOM ADS)
description:
Então o anúncio atual está incompleto, e ainda bem que paraste para pensar nisto. Vou explicar e depois refazê-lo.



O problema do anúncio atual: ele está afinado quase só para o replicador (a mensagem inteira gira à volta de “clona exatamente, não sejas criativo”). Mas tu acabaste de me dizer que ele também vai PRODUZIR criativo novo a partir dos teus scripts e briefs (os conceitos que saem da matriz). Essas duas funções pedem competências diferentes, e o anúncio atual filtra-as mal:

Para replicar: precisa de precisão, atenção ao detalhe, seguir à risca.

Para produzir do zero a partir de um brief: precisa de saber montar um UGC ou vídeo IA convincente a partir de um script e de direções, escolher os planos, o ritmo, fazer o gancho funcionar. Isto NÃO é criatividade livre (não inventa o conceito, o conceito vem do teu brief), mas é mais do que clonar. É execução criativa dentro de um brief.



Se publicares o anúncio como está, atrais clonadores puros que podem não saber pegar num script teu e construir um vídeo novo que converte. Filtras para metade do trabalho.



A solução: o anúncio tem de comunicar as DUAS funções com clareza, e distinguir bem “produzir a partir do nosso brief” de “inventar o teu próprio conceito”. A fronteira é: o conceito, o ângulo e o script vêm sempre de ti; ele executa-os em vídeo (seja produzindo do brief, seja replicando um vencedor). Ele nunca inventa a estratégia, mas tem de saber dar vida a um brief, não só copiar um vídeo existente.



Aqui está o anúncio refeito para o Cenário 3:



VIDEO EDITOR / AI CREATOR (ECOM ADS)



We are looking for a highly skilled Video Editor with extensive experience creating high-converting eCommerce and dropshipping video ads.



This is NOT a traditional video editing role. You will do two things for us, both demanding precision:



1. Build new ads from our briefs and scripts. We give you the concept, the angle, the script, and clear creative direction. You turn that into a high-converting UGC or AI-generated video ad. You are not inventing the strategy, we provide it, but you must know how to bring a brief to life: the right shots, pacing, hook, captions, and flow that make an ad actually convert.



2. Replicate winning ads into other languages. We give you a proven winning video, and you recreate an exact duplicate of it in another language, keeping the same structure, pacing, music, and feel. Here, precision is everything.



The line that matters



The concept, angle, and script always come from us. You execute them in video, brilliantly and precisely. We are NOT looking for someone who invents their own strategy, changes our scripts, or “improves” our concepts. We ARE looking for someone who can take our brief and produce an ad that performs, and who can replicate a winner with extreme accuracy when asked.



When replicating, you change only: language, product name, brand name, and avatar/actor (when required). Everything else stays identical: scene order, timing, pacing, background music, sound effects, transitions, captions, animations, visual effects, camera movement, structure, and flow.



Responsibilities

The concept, angle, and script always come from us. You execute them in video, brilliantly and precisely. We are NOT looking for someone who invents their own strategy, changes our scripts, or “improves” our concepts. We ARE looking for someone who can take our brief and produce an ad that performs, and who can replicate a winner with extreme accuracy when asked.



When replicating, you change only: language, product name, brand name, and avatar/actor (when required). Everything else stays identical: scene order, timing, pacing, background music, sound effects, transitions, captions, animations, visual effects, camera movement, structure, and flow.

- Reliable, consistent, and able to commit to a daily schedule

 software (screenshots and activity monitoring are standard for this role)

- Familiarity with YouTube, Amazon Influencer, TikTok, Instagram

- Interest in tech, gadgets or reviews



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE

title: Ongoing SEO Specialist for Leading UK Wedding Entertainment Brand
description:
About the business



Secret Service Singers is an established UK wedding and events entertainment company specialising in surprise singing waiter performances.



We have delivered thousands of performances, built a strong brand and won multiple industry awards. We are now looking for an experienced SEO specialist to significantly increase our organic visibility, website traffic and qualified wedding enquiries throughout the UK.



This is not a one-off SEO audit. We are looking for someone who can build and execute a long-term SEO strategy, with the objective of ranking our website on the first page of Google for valuable commercial searches related to singing waiters and wedding entertainment.



The objective



Your primary objective will be to increase our rankings, qualified organic traffic and genuine customer enquiries.



Priority search themes will include terms such as:



Singing waiters

Singing waiters UK

Surprise singing waiters

Singing waiters for weddings

Wedding singing waiters

Surprise wedding entertainment

Wedding entertainment ideas

Unique wedding entertainment

Singing waiters near me

Location-based singing waiter searches across major UK towns, cities and regions



We understand that legitimate SEO takes time and that nobody can honestly guarantee a specific Google ranking. However, we expect a clear strategy, consistent implementation, measurable progress and complete transparency.



Responsibilities



The successful candidate will be responsible for:



SEO strategy

Conducting a full audit of our current website and organic presence

Reviewing our competitors and identifying opportunities they are currently using

Creating a detailed 6 to 12-month SEO strategy

Identifying high-value commercial keywords with genuine booking potential

Prioritising work based on likely traffic, conversion potential and difficulty

Creating a realistic roadmap towards first-page rankings

Technical SEO

Auditing and improving website crawlability and indexation

Resolving broken links, redirect issues and duplicate content

Reviewing XML sitemaps and robots.txt

Improving website structure and URL structure

Implementing appropriate schema markup

Improving Core Web Vitals, mobile performance and page speed

Identifying problems through Google Search Console

Ensuring important pages are correctly indexed

Monitoring the website for technical errors

On-page SEO

Optimising titles, meta descriptions, headings and website copy

Improving existing service pages

Creating an effective internal linking structure

Improving image filenames, compression and alternative text

Strengthening the topical relevance of our website

Preventing keyword cannibalisation

Improving pages for both search rankings and customer conversions

Content strategy

Creating a content plan based on customer search behaviour

Producing detailed briefs for new pages and articles

Developing valuable wedding entertainment content rather than generic AI-generated articles

Identifying useful FAQs and informational searches

Updating existing content where improvements would produce faster results

Planning high-quality city, county and regional landing pages

Ensuring location pages are genuinely useful and not duplicated doorway pages

Local and national SEO

Improving our visibility for searches throughout the UK

Developing a safe and effective location-page strategy

Optimising our Google Business Profile where appropriate

Improving legitimate local citations and business information

Identifying regional wedding publications and partnership opportunities

Helping the brand compete nationally while targeting specific high-value locations

Authority and backlinks

Developing a safe, high-quality link acquisition strategy

Identifying relevant wedding venues, wedding blogs, suppliers, publications and industry websites

Conducting genuine outreach and digital PR

Reviewing existing backlinks and identifying potentially harmful links

Building authority through relevant editorial coverage and partnerships



We are not interested in bulk backlink packages, private blog networks, automated links, spam directories or any tactic that could damage the brand.



Tracking and reporting

Correctly setting up or reviewing Google Analytics 4

Reviewing Google Search Console

Tracking keyword rankings

Tracking enquiry form submissions, telephone calls and other conversions

Reporting on organic traffic and qualified leads

Providing a clear monthly report explaining:

Work completed

Ranking changes

Traffic changes

Enquiries and conversions

Technical issues found

Priorities for the following month



Reports must be clear and understandable. We do not want reports filled with statistics that do not connect to bookings or revenue.



Essential experience



Applicants must have:



Proven SEO experience with UK service businesses

Experience achieving strong rankings in competitive markets

Strong technical SEO knowledge

Experience with local and national SEO

Experience using Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console

Experience with keyword research and competitor analysis

Experience creating location-based SEO strategies

An understanding of conversion-focused website optimisation

Excellent written English

Clear and reliable communication



Experience within weddings, events, entertainment, hospitality or another lead-generation industry would be highly beneficial.



What we do not want



Please do not apply if your strategy mainly involves:



Buying hundreds of backlinks

Publishing large amounts of low-quality AI content

Keyword stuffing

Copying competitor articles

Creating duplicate location pages

Automated directory submissions

Making changes without explaining them

Promising guaranteed number-one rankings

Sending generic reports without demonstrating business results



All significant website changes must be explained and approved before implementation.



Initial project



The first stage will include:



A complete technical and on-page SEO audit

Competitor analysis

Keyword and search-intent research

An assessment of our current backlinks

A review of our existing website structure and content

A prioritised 90-day action plan

A proposed 6 to 12-month growth strategy

Recommendations for tracking rankings, enquiries and revenue



Following this initial stage, we are looking for continued monthly work implementing and managing the strategy.



Performance expectations



We will assess success using:



Improvements in rankings for commercially valuable searches

Growth in non-branded organic traffic

Increased visibility across UK locations

Increased qualified enquiries

Increased bookings generated through organic search

Improvements in website conversion rates

Growth in relevant referring domains and brand authority



Traffic alone is not the objective. We want people who are actively considering booking wedding entertainment.



Application requirements



Please include the following in your application:



A brief explanation of how you would approach SEO for a UK singing waiter and wedding entertainment company.

Two or three relevant examples of websites you have worked on.

Evidence of ranking, traffic or lead-generation improvements.

An explanation of exactly what work you personally completed.

The SEO tools you use.

Your preferred monthly working arrangement and availability.

Your estimated timeline for the audit and initial strategy.

What information or access you would require from us.

Your approach to backlinks and digital PR.

How you measure whether SEO is generating genuine enquiries and revenue.



Please begin your application with the words “Secret Service SEO” so we know you have read the full description.



Important application question



After briefly reviewing our industry, tell us:



Which three keyword areas you would prioritise first

Who you believe our main organic competitors are

The first three SEO improvements you would investigate



Generic or copy-and-paste applications will not be considered.



Working relationship



This is intended to become an ongoing relationship with the right person.



We are prepared to pay properly for proven skill, strategic thinking and measurable work. We are not searching for the lowest-cost applicant. However, we expect excellent value, honest communication and clear accountability.



Please provide either:



Your proposed monthly retainer and what it includes, or

Your hourly rate and estimated monthly hours



There is potential for continued long-term work as the business grows.

title: Electrical Designer
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for someone who has been working as a Mechanical Designer and would like to take the next step in their career with Royal Engineering! 

What We Do

At Royal Engineering, we help turn ideas into reality. We have been serving Utah and surrounding states for over 30 years, offering a niche service to our clients that focuses on Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) Engineering design for commercial buildings. This includes designing HVAC, lighting, power, and plumbing systems. We work closely with architects to integrate our designs with the overall building designs.



We help bring life to buildings. Without our designs, buildings would be dark, uncomfortable, and without indoor plumbing. We work with architects and project owners to bring about their vision. Many times, that vision is a culmination of a lifetime of planning for the project owner.

We create our designs utilizing Revit and AutoCAD software, but our product is much more than virtual plans. Our purpose is taking those virtual plans to actualization for the enjoyment of thousands. 



If you are passionate about seeing your ideas (in conjunction with the rest of the team) evolve into finished projects that will be part of our communities for decades, keep reading. If you’re looking for just any job to pay the bills, don’t read any further. Honestly, it would save both of us our time.

Our Values

Professional Interactions

We are respectful and courteous. We are responsive in our communications. We build lasting relationships with co-workers and clients Collaborate, Coordinate, Communicate

We listen to others and involve all those affected when solving problems. We are helpful and elevate others so they can do their best work



Quality Solutions

We are organized and detailed in our work to produce accurate designs. We look at alternatives in order to provide the best solution for the client Do the Right Thing

We are honest and do the right thing even when it’s hard. We are accountable for our actions and seek to correct any missteps



Make it Happen

We look for ways things can be done, rather than making excuses. We also speak up regarding what limitations exist. We are flexible when plans need to change.   Drive

We are passionate and positive about our work.  We are self-motivated and don’t wait to be told what to do. We are eager to learn and are willing to try new things, even with failure as a possibility.  We don’t let our past failures determine our future potential

Why Join Our Team

• This is a space that offers a true sense of community where the well-being of our employees is a top priority 

• We recognize everyone has a life outside of work.  We are flexible with individuals regarding personal needs and schedules

• We care about your personal and professional goals and will support you in those pursuits

• Fellow team members are helpful and want you to succeed

• You’ll get to see the progress of your ideas becoming reality

• You’ll have a variety of assignments that keep work interesting

Who You Are

You are a details person! You are detail oriented and analytical. You are willing to do the work so that the project is on time and on budget. 



You are passionate about leading you and your team to demonstrate excellent engineering skill. You constantly look for ways to make things better. You are organized and are able to delegate effectively. You don’t feel the need to do everything yourself. You find fulfillment in watching others learn and grow and improve their own lives.



You take ownership of your role and make independent decisions. You look at alternatives to make sure the right options are being considered. You know when to stop analyzing and to move forward with a decision.



You are excited to be part of making the company successful by creating, implementing, and following budgets and timelines, submitting reviews, and performing site inspections.  



You are happy to help other teams be successful, without worrying about who gets the credit.  

So, What Will You Be Doing?

While there will be many different tasks you will work on, you will ultimately be responsible for three important results:

• Verifying and staying on budget.

• Having the utmost quality in the project. Taking pride in the work that is done. 

• Being on time. The project has strict deadlines we need to adhere to. 



Feel like this is a fit? Read on!















Things You’ve Done in the Past

• Have you created your own plans or built items for personal use?  

• Experience in Revit and/or CAD. 

• Experience designing HVAC (including hydronics) and plumbing systems for schools, multi-family housing, office buildings, assisted living centers, warehouses, medical facilities, and other buildings





Why Should I be Interested?

• You’ll be part of a work that will be enjoyed by thousands.

• You’ll enjoy a strong culture of belonging.

• You’ll enjoy flexibility in personal and work life.

• You’ll have the freedom to streamline your area of work.

• You’ll be supported in your personal and professional development.

Are you the right person? 

If you’re excited about this opportunity, and feel like you have what it takes, we want to learn more about you!

s inside Klaviyo,

s per day (the majority will typically be for one or two clients so the workflow stays efficient)

 for a brand whose voice and positioning you are seeing for the first time? Walk us through your process from brand brief to finished copy.

 — headline through ender line — if the brief, brand references, and copy direction are all provided?

We are looking to grow very quickly over the next few months and this position will allow for opportunities to move into incentive-based pay and a salary increase. After 3 months, there will be a salary increase.

s to write :)

title: FOUNDING CREATIVE VIDEO ,MOTION DESIGNER
description:
FOUNDING CREATIVE VIDEO EDITOR & MOTION DESIGNER



Build the Future of Men’s Health

 Location: Remote



 Position: Part-Time / Full-Time



 Pay: $8–14 USD per hour (depending on experience and portfolio)



Start Date: Immediate







ENGNE is building the next generation of personalised men’s health.



Powered by DNA, epigenetics and AI, we’re creating a premium platform that helps men understand their unique biology so they can train smarter, recover better, optimise their health and perform at their highest level.



We’re looking for a Founding Creative Video Editor & Motion Designer to become one of the first key creative hires within our company.



This isn’t just another editing job.



It’s an opportunity to help shape the visual identity of a brand from day one.







About ENGNE



ENGNE exists to help men unlock their full potential through personalised health.



Using DNA, epigenetics and AI, we’re building a platform that gives men personalised insights into their body, allowing them to optimise their performance, recovery, longevity, testosterone, training and overall health.



ENGNE is built for ambitious men.



Elite athletes.



Footballers.



Basketball players.



Tennis players.



Combat sports athletes.



Gym-goers.



Entrepreneurs.



High performers.



And every man committed to becoming the best version of himself.



Our mission is simple:



Help men understand their biology, optimise their performance and live healthier, longer lives.







Why This Opportunity Is Different



Most editing jobs involve maintaining an existing brand.



This isn’t one of them.



ENGNE is at the beginning of its journey.



We have our brand strategy, identity and creative direction, but we’re starting with a blank canvas.



Our production begins immediately, and you’ll be joining at the perfect time to help establish the creative standards of the business.



The work you create won’t simply support the brand.



It will help build it.



If you’ve ever wanted the opportunity to leave your creative fingerprint on a company from day one, this is your chance.







The Role



Our production team will capture premium footage across athletes, gyms, health professionals, educational content, podcasts, product launches and behind-the-scenes content.



Your role is to transform that footage into premium, scroll-stopping content for:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok

*

* YouTube Shorts

* Long-form YouTube

* Paid advertising

* Brand campaigns

* Product launches

* Educational content

* Podcast clips

* Athlete stories

* Lifestyle content



Every piece of content should feel premium, modern and instantly recognisable as ENGNE.







What You’ll Be Editing



You’ll work with content featuring:



* Elite athletes

* Professional sports

* Men’s health

* DNA testing

* Epigenetics

* Recovery

* Longevity

* Performance

* Gym culture

* Health education

* AI-powered health insights

* Product launches

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Real customer stories

* Brand campaigns



No two weeks will ever be the same.







Who We’re Looking For



We’re not looking for someone who simply edits videos.



We’re looking for someone who understands how to build brands through content.



Someone who naturally thinks about:



* Storytelling

* Retention

* Hooks

* Pacing

* Emotion

* Motion graphics

* Typography

* Sound design

* Luxury branding

* Social media trends

* Visual identity



If you’re constantly analysing why some videos get millions of views while others don’t, you’ll fit in well here.







Essential Skills



You should be highly proficient in:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Adobe After Effects

* Motion graphics

* Professional typography

* Colour grading

* Sound design

* Social media editing

* Platform optimisation

* Organisation and file management

* Working independently

* Written and spoken English



You must have a portfolio that demonstrates premium-quality work.







Bonus Skills



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* DaVinci Resolve

* Blender

* Cinema 4D

* 3D animation

* Sports brands

* Health brands

* Fitness brands

* Luxury brands

* Technology brands

* Performance marketing creatives







The ENGNE Standard



We don’t create average content.



We don’t rely on templates.



We don’t produce forgettable edits.



Every frame should have purpose.



Every transition should add value.



Every caption should feel designed.



Every animation should strengthen the story.



Every video should elevate the ENGNE brand.



Quality always comes before quantity.







What You’ll Receive



* Premium brand guidelines

* Logo files and brand assets

* High-quality raw footage from our production team

* Direct communication with the founders

* Creative freedom to help shape the brand

* Long-term opportunity to grow with the business







This Role Is For You If…



? You’re obsessed with creating outstanding content.



? You care about the smallest details.



? You enjoy storytelling.



? You study successful content online.



? You love solving creative challenges.



? You want to help build something meaningful.



? You take pride in your work.



? You bring ideas, not just edits.







This Role Isn’t For You If…



? You only know basic editing.



? You rely heavily on templates.



? You’re not confident using After Effects.



? You struggle to work independently.



? You regularly miss deadlines.



? You don’t enjoy receiving feedback.



? You produce average work and are happy with “good enough.”







Our Hiring Philosophy



We care far more about talent than years of experience.



If your portfolio is exceptional, we don’t mind whether you’ve worked for one client or one hundred.



We’re looking for creativity, taste, attention to detail and someone who genuinely wants to help build a world-class brand.



Show us your best work not your biggest client.







How To Apply



Please send us:



* Your portfolio or showreel

* Links to your three strongest edits

* Examples of your After Effects or motion graphics work

* A short introduction about yourself

* Your availability

* Your expected hourly rate (within our advertised range)



Please also answer the following questions:



1. Why do you want to work with ENGNE?

2. Which three brands create the best content online today, and why?

3. Which edit are you most proud of, and what makes it special?

4. If you had complete creative freedom, what would you change about men’s health content?

5. Why should we choose you over every other applicant?



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.







Shortlisted Candidates



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing task using genuine ENGNE brand assets.



This gives us the opportunity to understand your creative thinking, storytelling ability and editing style.







Ready To Start?



We’re looking for someone who can start immediately.



Whether you’re looking for part-time or full-time work, we’re looking for the right person—not just someone to fill a position.



As ENGNE grows, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility and become a key part of our long-term creative team.







Final Message



We’re not looking for the fastest editor.



We’re looking for the one whose work people remember.



If you’re passionate about storytelling, obsessed with quality and want to help build one of the most exciting brands in men’s health from the ground up…



We’d love to hear from you.

description:

Excellent spoken and written English

Exceptional phone presence and communication skills

Strong leadership and ownership mentality

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Reliable internet and quiet professional workspace

Sales or business development experience

Experience managing teams

Experience with Open Dental, Dentrix, or Dentrix Ascend

Clinical dental experience (dentist, hygienist, treatment coordinator, office manager)



Compensation

Competitive hourly pay based on experience

Performance bonuses for growth and business development

Long-term leadership opportunity



Application Instructions



Put “DETAIL FIRST” in your application title.



Include a 3–5 minute video answering:



Tell us about your dental experience

Why are you a strong fit for this role?

Why should a dental office outsource insurance work to us?



Complete the technical and sales assessments provided below.



Assessment Part 1 — Technical Dental Knowledge 

Scenario 1: In-Network Claim Analysis



A PPO office is in-network with Delta Dental.



A patient receives:



A patient receives the following services:



• Crown (D2740)

Office Fee: $1,400

Allowed Amount: $900



• Core Build-Up (D2950)

Office Fee: $350

Allowed Amount: $180



• Bitewings

Office Fee: $120

Allowed Amount: $60



Insurance pays 80% for restorative and 100% for diagnostics/preventive.

The patient has $250 remaining deductible, and deductible applies to restorative services.

How much will insurance pay for each service?

What is the contractual write-off for each service?

If insurance underpaid, how would you verify the EOB?

Is there a contractual write-off? Why or why not?

A claim for scaling and root planing is denied with reason:

What documents would you gather for appeal?

Respond as if you’re on a live sales call.

title: Project Manager- Client Facing role
description:
This role bridges the gap between incoming clients, the internal recruitment team, and newly placed VAs — ensuring every activation is smooth, every client is ready, and every problem is escalated before it becomes a loss.



Key Responsibilities

Pre-Activation & Onboarding

• Conduct Pre-Activation Calls (PACs) with new clients to assess operational readiness before

VA deployment

• Identify and flag clients who are not yet operationally ready (e.g., missing business

access, unresolved business structure issues) and document gaps for follow-up

• Educate clients on the distinction between the one-time initiation fee and the ongoing VA

service fee to prevent confusion and churn

• Drive clients through resistance and hesitation (push-back vs. pushing through) to keep

activations on track



VA Activation Calls

• Facilitate VA Activation Calls, formally introducing the VA to the client and setting expectations

for the working relationship

• Track and report Time to Start — measured from the Pre-Activation Call to the Lead Completion

date — to monitor pipeline efficiency

• Maintain clear separation between PAC data and Activation Call data in all reporting and

tracking systems



Replacements & Client Retention

• Manage VA replacement requests, coordinating with recruitment and ensuring continuity of

service for the client

• Monitor client sentiment across active placements and flag clients requiring elevated attention or

intervention

• Identify patterns in no-shows and reschedules, escalate recurring issues to leadership with

supporting documentation

Reporting & Leadership Support

• Prepare and present a structured weekly report to leadership (Ryan) covering: new clients, VA

activation calls, time to start, replacements, client sentiment, clients needing focus, process

gaps, and escalation requests

• Maintain accurate weekly data and ensure prior-week figures are refreshed each reporting cycle

• Draft client-facing communications including scheduling
s, scope clarification messages,

and onboarding briefs

Process Improvement & Special Projects

• Develop and refine SOPs for the VA placement process, including visual workflow

documentation for agency clients

• Collaborate on automation initiatives (e.g., GoHighLevel workflows triggered by payment

confirmations)

• Build and maintain client-specific notes for VAs with unique needs — including tech support

requirements, government contract contexts, and special onboarding instructions



Client Management Context

This role requires the ability to manage a diverse client portfolio with varying levels of readiness,

technical sophistication, and operational maturity. The coordinator must exercise judgment in tailoring

their approach per client — from hands-on support for government contract clients (e.g., 
) to

patients, tech-supportive engagement for clients requiring additional onboarding time.



Skills & Competencies

• Strong verbal and written communication — able to handle client pushback professionally and

de-escalate concerns

• Highly organized with the ability to track multiple client pipelines simultaneously

• Comfortable with data tracking and translating raw call notes into structured weekly reports

• Familiarity with tools such as GoHighLevel (GHL), Notion, and presentation software

• Ability to identify process gaps proactively and propose solutions to leadership

• Discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive client situations or scope disputes

Reporting Structure. 



Reports directly to the CEO. Provides weekly briefings and flags escalation items requiring

leadership intervention, including recurring scheduling issues, client readiness problems, or at-risk

placements.



How to Apply

Kindly send your updated CV along with a short self-introduction to apply.

Incomplete applications will not be acknowledged. Thank you!

title: Remote General Manager / Business Operations Manager for Hawaii Prefab Company
description:
Paa Prefab is a growing prefab housing and building-products company on the Big Island of Hawaii. We sell prefab buildings, storage and office units, container-style spaces, and related building products for customers who need practical, affordable space.



I am hiring a remote General Manager / Business Operations Manager to help run the parts of the company that need consistent follow-through, organization, reporting, research, and systems.



This role is for someone who can take ownership across multiple areas of the business: finance admin, marketing coordination, sales follow-up, procurement research, customer communication, supplier tracking, project organization, and internal systems.



I am looking for someone who can operate independently, solve problems, create structure, maintain standards, and make the business easier to run without needing constant hand-holding.



You will work directly with the owner. Your job is to own the operating rhythm of the business, keep work moving, surface decisions clearly, and reduce the number of things that fall back on the owner.



Financial, marketing, and sales as well as management success, a hunger and will to succeed, strong problem solving, and the track-record to prove it.



Core Areas You Will Help Own



Finance and Regulatory Admin



You will help keep the business financially organized and legally in compliance of tax and other accounting requirements.



This may include:



 • Organizing invoices, receipts, quotes, payments, and vendor records.

 • Researching required State, Federal Tax and other required reporting/submissions on time.

 • Tracking customer deposits, balances due, payment status, and follow-up needs.

 • Preparing simple finance summaries for owner review.

 • Coordinating with bookkeepers, accountants, or outside finance support.

 • Flagging missing documents, unpaid balances, unusual charges, or unclear records.

 • Helping prepare clean records for taxes, bookkeeping, and reporting.



You will not be expected to make final financial decisions without approval, but you should be able to keep the finance admin side organized and visible.



Sales Operations



You will help make sure leads and customers do not fall through the cracks.



This may include:



 • Managing CRM records and lead pipelines.

 • Tracking every lead’s status and next step.

 • Drafting customer replies and follow-up messages.

 • Preparing quote information for owner review.

 • Making sure customer questions get answered or escalated.

 • Tracking interested customers, serious buyers, quote requests, deposits, and delivery status.

 • Identifying which leads need urgent attention.



The goal is not just to reply to messages. The goal is to help build a reliable sales follow-up system.



Marketing Coordination



You will help keep marketing organized and active.



This may include:



 • Coordinating
 Marketplace listings and social media posts.

 • Organizing product photos, descriptions, pricing notes, and listing copy.

 • Tracking which products are listed where.

 • Watching competitor listings and local market pricing.

 • Helping draft ads, posts, flyers,
s, and simple marketing campaigns.

 • Tracking which marketing channels are producing leads.

 • Suggesting improvements based on what customers are asking about.



Marketing should be practical, consistent, and safe for the business. No spam tactics, fake accounts, risky shortcuts, or sloppy public claims.



Procurement and Supplier Research



You will help research and organize supplier options.



This may include:



 • Researching prefab buildings, container units, sheds, storage units, roofing systems, panels, accessories, tools, materials, and related products.

 • Comparing suppliers, pricing, shipping, minimum order quantities, lead times, and product specs.

 • Organizing supplier quotes and conversations.

 • Preparing comparison summaries.

 • Asking suppliers clear questions.

 • Tracking open supplier issues and follow-ups.

 • Helping identify better products, better margins, or better sourcing options.



The goal is to help the owner make faster, better purchasing decisions.



Operations and Project Coordination



You will help turn messy daily business activity into clear systems.



This may include:



 • Creating trackers, checklists, SOPs, templates, dashboards, and simple workflows.

 • Preparing daily and weekly owner updates.

 • Tracking open decisions, blockers, customer promises, supplier follow-ups, and delivery issues.

 • Organizing documents, photos, product details, quotes, invoices, contracts, and project records.

 • Keeping important information easy to find.

 • Noticing repeated problems and suggesting fixes.



The strongest person for this role will not wait for every task to be assigned. They will notice what is missing and help create order.



Looking For: Strong General Manager Traits



I am looking for someone who is:



 • Excellent in written English.

 • Highly organized and reliable.

 • Calm under pressure.

 • Graceful and professional at all times, with customers, vendors, and coworkers.

 • A self-starter who does not need to be chased.

 • Comfortable owning several business areas at once.

 • Good at turning messy information into clear next steps.

 • Strong at follow-up, reminders, tracking, and documentation.

 • Able to maintain business standards even when things are moving quickly.

 • Able to make practical recommendations, not just collect information.

 • Comfortable making judgment calls and explaining your reasoning.

 • Careful with customer promises, pricing, permitting, delivery details, and anything that could create confusion.

 • Honest when you do not know something.

 • Able to work independently while keeping the owner informed.

 • Practical, direct, and action-oriented.



The strongest candidate will think like a general manager, chief of staff, or operations lead — someone who sees what needs to happen, organizes it, and helps make it happen.



Looking For: Useful Experience



Direct construction experience is helpful, but it is not required.



I am interested in people who have managed complexity in real business environments. Strong candidates may come from many backgrounds, including:



 • Operations management for a small business.

 • Finance admin, bookkeeping coordination, invoice tracking, or payment follow-up.

 • Sales operations, CRM management, lead follow-up, or quote coordination.

 • Marketing coordination, social media listings, Marketplace, paid ads, or local business marketing.

 • Procurement, supplier research, vendor management, importing, shipping, or product comparison.

 • Logistics, dispatch, delivery coordination, warehouse coordination, or inventory management.

 • Trades businesses, contractor offices, repair businesses, mechanical services, equipment rental, automotive, marine, appliance, solar, or other hands-on service businesses.

 • Real estate, property management, hospitality, events, or other high-pressure customer-facing operations.

 • Coordinating many moving parts across customers, vendors, schedules, documents, and money records.

 • CRM tools, Airtable, HubSpot, Notion, Trello, Linear, Google Sheets, or similar systems.

 • Working for a US, Australian, Canadian, or UK business.

 • ChatGPT or other AI tools used for real business operations.

 • Building trackers, dashboards, checklists, SOPs, or simple systems for a growing company.



What matters most is not the exact industry. What matters is whether you can manage complexity, maintain standards, communicate clearly, and keep moving with calm, charm, and good judgment.



Looking For: Work Style



The business moves fast. Some things will be messy. Your job is to help make them clear.

I value short, useful updates. I do not need long vague reports. I want information that helps decisions happen faster.



Looking For: AI Tool Judgment



I want someone who can use AI tools well, but not blindly.



Good AI use means:



 • Using ChatGPT to draft, summarize, organize, compare, and speed up research.

 • Checking facts before relying on them.

 • Editing AI output so it sounds human, specific, and accurate.

 • Knowing when a customer-facing message needs owner approval.

 • Separating facts, assumptions, and open questions.

 • Never using AI as an excuse for sloppy work or for a lack of accountability for the work you do.



How To Apply



Please reply with:



 1 A short introduction in your own words.

 2 Your relevant experience.

 3 Why you think you are a fit for a General Manager / Business Operations Manager role.

 4 Your expected monthly salary in USD.

 5 Your available working hours in Philippine time.

 6 Your available overlap with Hawaii time, if you know it.

 7 A specific example of a messy process, tracker, system, or workflow you improved.

 8 A specific example of a time you solved a business problem without waiting for your boss to tell you every step.

 9 A specific example of a time you stayed calm and effective in a fast-moving or high-pressure situation.

 10 Which areas you are strongest in: finance admin, marketing, sales operations, procurement, customer follow-up, project coordination, systems, logistics, vendor management, or research.

 11 What tools you are comfortable with: spreadsheets, CRM, Google Workspace, ChatGPT, Notion, Airtable, Trello, etc.



Please also answer these questions:



Question 1:

A potential customer asks about a prefab home but gives incomplete information. What information would you collect before the owner spends time preparing a quote?



Question 2:

A customer asks: “Can I live in this? Is it permitted? I’m in Puna and need something cheap fast.” How would you reply?



Question 3:

You notice that leads are coming from
, text messages, phone calls, and referrals, but there is no reliable system for tracking who needs follow-up. What would you build first?



Question 4:

You are researching a new supplier. What information would you collect before recommending whether we should consider buying from them?



Question 5:

Describe a business environment where you had to manage many moving parts at once. What standards did you maintain, and how did you keep things from falling through the cracks?



Optional: Tell me how you currently use ChatGPT or AI tools in your work, and how you check the output before using it.



Applications that are generic, copy-pasted, or obviously AI-written without personal detail will be skipped.



Paid Test Task



Strong applicants may be invited to complete a short paid test task before hiring.



The test may include:



 • Creating a lead follow-up tracker.

 • Drafting a customer follow-up message.

 • Creating a quote-prep checklist.

 • Summarizing supplier/product options.

 • Writing a daily owner update.

 • Creating a basic finance/admin tracker for invoices, deposits, balances due, and missing records.

 • Recommending a simple operating system for managing leads, suppliers, quotes, marketing tasks, and follow-ups.

 • Explaining which customer, finance, pricing, permitting, or public-facing issues should require owner approval.



I am looking for judgment, clarity, structure, independence, follow-through, calm under pressure, and practical thinking.



Compensation



This is a serious full-time role.



Pay is USD $2,000/month for the right person.



I am willing to pay well for someone who is independent, reliable, organized, calm, honest, and able to take ownership of finance admin, sales operations, marketing coordination, procurement research, logistics support, vendor follow-up, and business systems so the company can run with less owner involvement.

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you’re interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.



Why strong setters join us



We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth.



If you’re experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.



01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there’s no ceiling on what you can earn each month.



02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You’ll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what’s working, coach on what isn’t, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.



03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You’ll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise



Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed

Per qualified appointment: $50 USD — every one, on top of the base

Status bonus: 10–20% of closed deals the following month



The status bonus — how it works:



Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads.



Hit 12 = 10%

Hit 16 = 15%

Hit 20 = 20%



The more consistent you are, the more it compounds. At Bronze level, that’s an extra ~$375/month. At Gold level, that’s an extra ~$1,250/month — all on top of your base and per-appointment pay.



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)

That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).



This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that’s you, and you’re comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.



To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we’ll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you’ll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.



Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote.



Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.



Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.



Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.



Who we’re looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.



A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.



Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.



Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.



Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.



What you’re walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously.

Uncapped commission. Base starting 30k-50k PHP/month + commission per closed deal that you set + residual recurring commission (Wise/Payoneer paid bi-weekly). Top setters double their base monthly when the closer converts. 13th month considered for long-term hires.

 subject must start with "SDR777" and include your name

- Excellent written English

- Working knowledge of FCRA, FDCPA, and CROA

- Experience filing CFPB / FTC complaints

- Reliable computer and internet available during EST overlap hours

- Prior U.S. credit repair experience

Apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph by sending me a message. To show me you read the full post, start your message with the word "ACCURACY." Applications without it will be ignored.

title: Dating App Assistant
description:
Personal Dating App Manager (Ghostwriter–Operator)





I'm hiring someone to run the day-to-day of my dating profiles. You're the engine behind the scenes: curating matches, opening conversations, keeping promising ones warm, and getting the good ones to a scheduled date. I handle the actual dates — you handle everything up to them.



This is fast AI-assisted drafting with light judgment, not pure copy-paste. You'll use tools to generate options quickly, but you read the thread and pick or adjust so it lands like a real person. The difference between a date and a dead conversation is usually one good reply at the unexpected 
nt — that's the skill I'm hiring for.



Apps you'd manage: [Hinge / Bumble / Tinder / etc.]

Goal: [be specific — e.g. "consistent, quality first dates with people I'd actually click with"]





What you'll do





Review and curate matches against a preferences brief I'll give you

Write openers and carry conversations in my voice

Keep 
ntum: timely replies, good questions, knowing when to ask someone out

Handle the "message three" save — when someone says something the script didn't anticipate, you keep it alive

Flag standout matches to me before any date is set

Maintain a clean log of who's who so threads never cross

Suggest tweaks to my photos and bio over time based on what's landing

Edit and prep my profile photos — light retouching, cropping, ordering, and basic cleanup so the profile always looks its best (no heavy/deceptive editing; the photos still have to look like me)







Tools & Workflow



You'll operate a defined stack so the work is fast and consistent. I'll provide access and a voice brief.





Drafting — YourMove AI (default engine for openers and replies). [Swap/secondary: SmoothRizz if we prioritize voice-consistency.]

Match tracking — Wingman (AI Dating Coach app): a profile per person so we track what's been said and what's worked, and never cross threads. Also our photo/bio optimizer.

Delivery — the actual apps, by hand. You log in and type inside [Hinge/Bumble/Tinder]. No automation or auto-senders — those get accounts banned. [Optional: Keys AI keyboard to speed up in-app typing, on the dedicated device only.]

Access — 1Password (or Bitwarden): you get login access without raw credentials; I can revoke instantly.

Brief & coordination — shared Notion doc: my voice, preferences, and standing rules live here.

Photo editing — [Lightroom Mobile / Snapseed / Canva / TouchRetouch]: for cropping, light retouching, ordering, and cleanup. Use whichever you're fluent in; just keep edits natural.





The rhythm: read the thread ? generate options ? pick the one that fits and tweak it to sound like me ? send ? log anything worth remembering. Seconds of judgment per message, not minutes of writing.





Who I'm looking for





A genuinely strong, natural writer with range — funny, warm, or sharp depending on the person

High emotional intelligence and a good read on subtext

Comfortable using AI tools to draft fast and the judgment to know when a suggestion is off

Competent with basic photo editing — cropping, light retouching, and selecting the strongest shots

Discreet and trustworthy — this is my actual dating life

Responsive during [active hours]

Bonus: you've done this kind of work before, or you're just unusually good at texting







Confidentiality



You'll have access to my accounts and personal conversations. A basic confidentiality agreement is part of the role — non-negotiable, and I'll provide it before any account access.





How to apply — the screening



I'm using a few short steps instead of a résumé, because the work is the audition.



Step 1 — Quick intro + read-the-brief check (5 min).

A short note answering: why does this kind of work appeal to you? Then, so I know you actually read instructions before acting:





Start your message with the word "Banana."

Keep the whole note under 100 words.

End with one line confirming you're comfortable signing a confidentiality agreement.





No cover letter — keep it human. (If you skip any of the three, I'll assume the instruction-following part of the job isn't a fit, and won't move forward. This is the filter, not a formality.)



Step 2 — Work sample (writing + photo).

I'll send a mock match profile and one sample photo. You'll:





Write the opener you'd send them.

Rewrite this bland bio to make it pull: "[insert a boring sample bio]"

Do a quick, natural edit of the sample photo (crop + light cleanup) and send it back — show me you can make a shot look its best without making it look fake.





Step 3 — The message-three save (the real filter).

I'll give you a conversation that's gone cold, or a match who said something slightly off or unexpected. Show me how you'd recover or respond. This tells me more than anything else.



Step 4 — Paid trial.

Top candidates do a [1–2 week] paid trial on a live account, with me reviewing before anything sends. If it clicks, we make it ongoing.



To start: reply with Step 1 and I'll send the Step 2 brief.





Notes for me before posting: lock the rate and hours (vague pay attracts vague applicants — even a range sharpens the pool a lot), confirm which apps I'm listing, and run YourMove + Wingman through their free trials on my real threads first so I know the stack actually works before handing it off.
