Full-Time | Remote | Exclusive to White Orchid Hospice



White Orchid Hospice is looking for an experienced, highly motivated Hospice Healthcare Recruiter to lead full-cycle recruiting for all four of our hospice locations.



We are not looking for a passive recruiter who just posts jobs and waits. We want someone who knows how to find talent, create interest, build urgency, and close candidates. This role requires a recruiter who is confident, proactive, organized, and excellent at selling candidates on our company and opportunity.



If you have strong healthcare recruiting experience, direct hospice recruiting experience, and the ability to communicate naturally and confidently with Americans, we want to hear from you.



What You’ll Do

You will manage the recruiting process from start to finish across multiple locations. This includes sourcing candidates, reviewing resumes, screening applicants, coordinating interviews, following up consistently, helping move candidates through the hiring process, and supporting successful hires.



You must be able to recruit aggressively, keep pipelines active, and generate quality candidates for hospice-related openings. Just as importantly, you must be able to represent White Orchid Hospice well and effectively communicate why candidates should choose to join our team.



What We Need

You must have at least 5 years of healthcare recruiting experience and at least 2 years of direct hospice healthcare recruiting experience. This is required.



You must be fluent in English, both written and verbal, and able to communicate smoothly with Americans without the conversation feeling difficult or awkward because you are overseas.



You must be confident on calls, strong in candidate follow-up, and skilled at building trust and excitement with potential hires. We are looking for someone who can sell, not just screen.



This is a fully dedicated role. You must be committed exclusively to White Orchid Hospice and cannot have any other jobs, clients, contracts, or side work.



Ideal Candidate

The right person is aggressive, responsive, persuasive, and dependable. You know how to source, engage, and close healthcare talent. You understand the pace and demands of hospice recruiting. You are comfortable managing multiple openings at once and know how to stay organized, move fast, and communicate clearly.



Requirements

To be considered, you must meet all of the following:



Minimum 5 years of healthcare recruiting experience

Minimum 2 years of direct hospice healthcare recruiting experience

Strong English communication skills, both spoken and written

Ability to communicate comfortably and professionally with Americans

Proven ability to source, engage, and close candidates

Strong full-cycle recruiting experience

Must be fully dedicated to White Orchid Hospice only

No other active jobs, clients, or outside work commitments

Why This Role Matters

This is an important position for our organization. You will directly impact our ability to grow strong teams across all four locations. We need someone who can take ownership of recruiting, work with urgency, and help us hire great people who fit our mission and standards.



How to Apply

When applying, please include a short message answering the following:



How many years of healthcare recruiting experience do you have?

How many years of direct hospice recruiting experience do you have?

What hospice positions have you recruited for?

Are you currently working for any other employer or client?

Can you commit exclusively to White Orchid Hospice?

Why are you a strong fit for this role?

title: Content Strategist
description:
SHOOT & SCALE

About Shoot & Scale

Shoot & Scale is a fast-growing social media marketing agency specializing in short-form content for service-based businesses. We help brands build awareness, grow their audience, and generate leads through strategic content on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. We work with a tight-knit team that moves fast, cares deeply about quality, and is obsessed with results.

 

The Role

We’re looking for a sharp, creative, and highly organized Content Fulfillment Manager to lead the fulfillment side of our agency. This is not a junior position — you will own the entire client fulfillment pipeline, from content strategy and scripting to QA and client communication. You will be the main point of contact ensuring every client receives outstanding, on-brand content on time, every time.

 

If you eat, sleep, and breathe short-form content — if you understand why a hook works, how a format drives retention, and what makes a viewer stop scrolling — this role was built for you.

 

Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Scripting

•       Develop and execute monthly content strategies for multiple clients across service-based niches

•       Write compelling short-form video scripts tailored to each client’s voice, audience, and goals

•       Select and apply the right formats, hooks, and topics for each piece of content

•       Review and revise scripts based on client feedback, ensuring brand alignment and quality on every round

•       Stay ahead of trends, viral formats, and emerging hooks across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

 

Client Communication & Fulfillment

•       Serve as the primary fulfillment contact for all clients — send scripts, collect feedback, and manage revision rounds

•       Keep clients informed and confident at every stage of the content process

•       Maintain clear timelines and ensure all deliverables are sent on schedule

•       Handle client revisions promptly and professionally, incorporating feedback without losing creative quality

 

Video QA & Creative Direction

•       Review all video edits produced by our editing team before delivery to clients

•       Provide detailed, specific QA notes on pacing, captions, visual hooks, B-roll, transitions, and overall look-and-feel

•       Ensure every video is polished, on-brand, and meets Shoot & Scale’s quality standards

•       Develop and refine internal QA checklists and editing briefs to raise the bar consistently

 

Fulfillment Department Leadership

•       Own the fulfillment department end-to-end — systems, workflows, quality, and output

•       Identify bottlenecks and proactively build processes that keep the team efficient and clients happy

•       Work closely with the founding team to improve and scale fulfillment operations

 

What We’re Looking For

Content Knowledge & Skills

•       Deep understanding of short-form video content: hooks, formats, topics, visual hooks, and content strategy

•       Proven ability to write scripts that are engaging, clear, and built to perform

•       Strong eye for design, aesthetics, and video quality — you notice what looks off instantly

•       Familiarity with content performance principles and what drives views, saves, and shares

 

Communication & Language

•       Fully English — written and spoken, professional level in both

•       Comfortable communicating with clients in English

•       Clear, professional, and warm communicator — clients should feel taken care of

 

Work Style & Mindset

•       Extremely organized and detail-oriented — you juggle multiple clients without dropping the ball

•       Self-directed and proactive — you don’t wait to be told what needs fixing

•       High standards for your own work and for the work that goes out under your name

•       Comfortable in a fast-paced, growing agency environment where things evolve quickly

•       Reliable internet and availability during standard business hours

 

Nice to Have

•       Prior experience at a social media marketing or content agency

•       Experience with CapCut, Canva, or similar tools for reviewing and annotating edits

•       Familiarity with project management tools (GoHighLevel, Asana, Frame.io, etc.)

•       Experience working with service-based business clients (coaches, consultants, agencies, etc.)

 

What You’ll Get

•       Fully remote position — work from anywhere

•       40 hours/week with a stable, long-term engagement

•       A clear ownership role — you’re not a cog, you run the department

•       A collaborative, growth-oriented team that values your ideas and initiative

•       The opportunity to build systems, grow a team, and shape fulfillment operations as the agency scales

 

How to Apply

To apply, please send the following to 

 

•       Your resume or LinkedIn profile

•       A short video (60–120 seconds) introducing yourself and explaining why you’re the right fit for this role

•       Two examples of short-form video content you’ve scripted or strategized (links preferred)

•       A brief answer (3–5 sentences) to this question: “What makes a great hook, and how do you decide which hook to use for a given piece of content?”

 

Applications without the video introduction will not be reviewed. We want to see how you communicate — this is a client-facing role.

 

Shoot & Scale · 

Short-Form Content That Grows Service Brands.

This is an ongoing, evolving operational role where you own the engine that keeps our service delivery running.

That means when a new client signs up and pays, you're the one kicking off the project. When a tea
mber is stuck, you're the one unblocking them. When a process is broken or slow, you're the one building the system to fix it. When a client needs an update, you're the one making sure it happens.

Project & Task Management

You'll manage everything inside ClickUp — creating tasks, building templates, automations, keeping statuses up to date, making sure projects are moving forward on schedule. When something stalls, you catch it before anyone else does.

We have a small remote team across different time zones. You'll make sure everyone is clocking in on time, communicating in the right Slack channels, and delivering their work. When someone needs support, you provide it. When someone isn't pulling their weight, you address it.



Client Communication

You'll handle day-to-day client updates, follow-ups, and back-and-forth communication. You're the bridge between our clients and our team. Clients should feel looked after. your job is to provide an exceptional customer experience.



Systems, Automations & SOPs

As the business grows, new processes need to be built. You'll create automations, write SOPs, set up Slack channels and workflows, and continuously improve how we operate. If there's a better way to do something, you find it and build it.



General Operational Ownership

Things come up. Fires happen. New needs emerge. If it falls under "keeping the business running and delivering for clients," it's your responsibility. This role evolves as the business evolves — that's the nature of operations.



Tools You'll Use Daily



ClickUp 

Google Drive

Slack 

WhatsApp

Pabbly 

Claude 

GHL



Who You Are



You are a leader. You're proactive. You don't wait to be told what to do — you see what needs doing and you handle it.

You're organized and detail-oriented. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.

You're reliable. You show up on time, every day, during the agreed window. No disappearing acts, no random schedule changes without notice.

You're a strong communicator. You can talk to clients professionally and coordinate a remote team clearly.

You're comfortable building systems. Whether it's an automation, an SOP, or a new workflow in ClickUp, you can figure it out and build it.

title: AI Creative Specialist
description:
TO APPLY

If this opportunity feels like the perfect fit for you and you meet the job qualifications, we invite you to learn more about our HiEnd Accents team in the Philippines and submit your application here:

https://airtable(dot) com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagWFW91EJQpT08fw/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.



Applications submitted through onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.



JOB DESCRIPTION



We're looking for a full-time AI Creative Specialist to lead the creation of AI-generated product imagery, lifestyle scenes, and short-form video for our brands, including HiEnd Accents and Paseo Road. You'll take our products from a flat studio shot to fully-realized lifestyle photography and video creative used across our website, paid social ads,
 campaigns, and Pinterest. You'll own the full pipeline: writing prompts, generating images and videos with tools like Gemini (Nano Banana Pro), Midjourney, Kling, and Veo, finishing them in Photoshop/Canva if needed, and assembling them into finished ad creatives.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Generate photorealistic lifestyle product photography using AI image tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, or similar), placing our bedding, pillows, rugs, and home textiles into believable room scenes, on-model shots, and editorial-style compositions



- Animate hero images into short-form video using Kling, Veo 3/3.1, or comparable image-to-video tools for use in Meta ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and on-site PDP video



- Write, test, and continuously refine your own prompts, building reusable prompt templates and a library of looks that maintain visual consistency across each brand



- Build finished static and video ad creatives (Meta, Pinterest, Google) by combining AI-generated imagery with on-brand text overlays, logos, and sizing variants



- Finish and retouch every AI output in Photoshop, Canva, and/or Lightroom, fixing hands, edges, lighting, fabric texture, and any AI artifacts before delivery so nothing leaves your hands looking AI-generated



- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required



- Strong prompt engineering skills: you can read a product brief and write a prompt that nails the scene, mood, and composition on the first or second pass



- Hands-on experience with AI image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, or Pika, with a portfolio of short clips you've produced



- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or Lightroom for retouching and finishing AI outputs (fixing artifacts, color correction, compositing) and for ad layout and text treatment



- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock



- Self-motivated, organized, and professional, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple brands and brief types; able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Comfortable working with our team via email, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive



- Full-time position, 40 hrs/week



- Excel as a team player, contributing positively to our collective success.





ABOUT HIEND ACCENTS



HiEnd Accents designs and sells premium bedding and home textiles (quilts, sheets, decorative pillows, duvets, and more) that bring everyday luxury into people's homes. We've been family-owned and operated since 2005, now in our second generation of leadership, and are headquartered in Dallas, Texas.



We serve thousands of retailers, interior designers, department stores, and boutique hotels across the United States through four distinct brands spanning a range of styles and price points. Our growth has been recognized nationally: we've been named to the Inc. 5000 (a prestigious list of America's fastest-growing private companies) two years running, and have received multiple industry awards for product excellence.



We're a company of around 45 people, small enough that every person matters, established enough that you're joining something real and growing.



WHY HIEND ACCENTS?



We're growing our team in the Philippines because we believe in finding the best people regardless of geography, and investing in them for the long term.



As a family-owned company, we don't treat our team members as interchangeable. We take the time to build real working relationships, we care about your professional development, and we want every person who works with us to leave with stronger skills than when they started. That's a genuine commitment from our leadership, not a line in a job posting.



What you can expect:



You'll work directly with our core team in Texas, not through layers of management or a BPO intermediary. Your contributions will be visible, your ideas heard, and your growth supported.



- Compensation & Benefits: Competitive pay benchmarked to PH market rates for skilled roles, not entry-level floors. Paid time off including vacation days and holidays, plus 13th-month pay.



- Real Career Growth: We're expanding quickly, which means new roles and responsibilities open up regularly. We actively develop our people through mentorship, skill-building, and increasing ownership of projects.



- A Team That Feels Like a Team: We're a close, collaborative group that celebrates wins together. You'll know your teammates by name, including leadership.





HiEnd is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Product Design Engineer & CAD Drafter | Aluminium Extrusions & Injection Moulding
description:
THE ROLE



We're an Australian architectural building products company at an active stage of product development  new components, new systems, and an expanding product range across two brands. We're looking for a skilled product design engineer and CAD drafter to join us long-term, full-time, and take that development through to production-ready documentation.



This is hands-on technical work. You'll take concepts and specifications and turn them into accurate, professional production drawings the kind a manufacturer can work from without a phone call. Aluminium extrusion profiles and injection-moulded components are our primary focus.



THE BUSINESSES



A premium electrically operable louvre pergola system designed and engineered in Australia, supplied to architects, builders, commercial operators and developers.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



- Producing accurate 3D models in OnShape, Sketchup or SolidWorks from briefs, sketches and specifications

- Drafting production drawings for aluminium extrusion profiles — die drawings, cross-sections, dimensional tolerances

- Drafting production drawings for injection-moulded components part geometry, draft angles, wall thickness, tolerances, material callouts

- Producing shop drawings to a standard that can go directly to a fabricator or manufacturer

- Converting and exporting files between formats (STEP, DXF, DWG, PDF and similar) as required

- Maintaining and organising the product drawing library with clean version control

- Supporting the product development process as new components and systems are designed.

- Also need to have experience with Sketchup, this is important. 



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Non-negotiable:

- Demonstrated experience producing manufacturing drawings for aluminium extrusion profiles, or fabricated parts, injection-moulded components and die cast parts. 

- Proven ability to produce clean, complete shop drawings from a written specification or sketch

- Proficiency in OnShape — this is our preferred platform. SolidWorks will be considered for candidates with strong manufacturing drawing experience

- File conversion across common engineering formats (STEP, DXF, DWG, PDF)

- Strong attention to detail — drawings go to manufacturers; errors cost money

- Reliable, self-directed and able to manage your own workload



Advantageous:

- Background in architectural, construction or building products environments

- Experience with aluminium systems — pergolas, facades, windows, louvres or similar

- Familiarity with Australian or international drafting standards

- Experience working with Australian clients



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Long-term engagement — this is not a project post

- Our team works 7:00 am – 3:00 pm Perth, Western Australia time (WST / UTC+8)

- We're flexible on timezone for the right candidate please tell us where you are and your preferred working hours in your application



HOW TO APPLY



Please include all of the following — applications without these items will not be reviewed:



1. A brief introduction: your background, the industries you've worked in, and the types of products you've drafted

2. Portfolio examples — screenshots or files showing production drawings you've completed for aluminium extrusion profiles and/or injection-moulded components. Show us drawings that went to a manufacturer, not student or tutorial work

3. Confirmation of your primary CAD platform (OnShape or SolidWorks) and your proficiency level

4. Your location and preferred working hours

5. Your hourly rate in USD

title: Production & Supply Chain Manager (Apparel)
description:
REMOTE WORK OPPORTUNITY ALERT



Role: Production & Supply Chain Manager (Apparel)

Code: BVA-0001

Type of Contract: Full-Time (40hrs per week)

Hourly or Monthly Rate: $1000-$1750 per month

Schedule: 9am to 6pm Philippine Time

Years of Experience: 5+ years of experience in apparel production, sourcing, merchandising, or factory management.



Role Description:



We are seeking an experienced Production & Sourcing Manager to oversee apparel production across multiple factory partners in China.



This role is responsible for ensuring orders are produced on time, meet quality standards, and move efficiently from development through shipment. You will serve as the primary point of contact between our team and our manufacturing partners, managing production schedules, solving factory issues, coordinating logistics, and sourcing new suppliers when needed.



The ideal candidate has extensive experience working directly with apparel factories, understands garment construction and production processes, and is highly organized when managing multiple orders simultaneously.

Mandarin language skills are highly preferred but not required.



Tasks and Responsibilities:



1. Production Management

- Own the production calendar from purchase order through shipment.

- Track all active orders across multiple factories and ensure milestones are met.

- Maintain accurate production timelines and proactively identify delays before they become issues.

- Hold factories accountable for deadlines and production commitments.

- Escalate timing risks and recommend solutions before customer deadlines are impacted.



2. Factory Communication

- Serve as the primary daily point of contact with factory partners primarily through WeChat.

- Follow up continuously on production status, materials, samples, and shipment readiness.

- Build strong relationships with factory management teams while maintaining accountability.

- Ensure factories clearly understand product specifications

- timelines and expectations.



3. Product Development & Sampling

- Review tech packs, specifications, measurements, materials, and construction details.

- Coordinate sample development from initial concept through production approval.

- Verify samples meet requirements before bulk production begins.

- Identify construction, fit, quality or manufacturing concerns early in the process.



4. Quality Control

- Monitor production quality across all active orders.

- Identify and resolve defects, workmanship concerns, material inconsistencies, and specification issues.

- Coordinate third-party inspections when necessary.

- Work with factories to implement corrective actions and prevent recurring issues.



5. Factory Sourcing & Vendor Management

- Research, identify, and qualify new factories for existing and future product categories.

- Request and evaluate factory capabilities, pricing, minimums, lead times, and quality standards.

- Build a network of reliable manufacturing partners.

- Assist with transitioning production away from underperforming suppliers when necessary.



6. Logistics & Shipping Coordination

- Coordinate production handoffs from factory completion through shipment.

- Ensure goods are properly inspected, packed, labeled, and prepared for export.

- Work with freight forwarders and logistics partners to maintain shipping schedules.

- Monitor shipment timelines and communicate delays or risks immediately.



7. Reporting & Operational Support

- Provide regular production status updates to leadership.

- Maintain clear visibility into what is on schedule, at risk, or delayed.

- Track factory performance metrics including on-time delivery, quality performance, and responsiveness.

- Recommend process improvements that improve speed, quality, and efficiency.



What We're Looking For:



This is not a coordinator role.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership, follows up relentlessly, solves problems independently, and keeps production moving without needing constant oversight.



The right candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable pushing factories for answers, and capable of managing dozens of active orders at the same time.



Role Qualifications:

- Mandarin language proficiency.

- Experience sourcing and onboarding new factories.

- Experience coordinating international freight and logistics.

- Experience working with custom apparel, embroidery, screen printing, and cut-and-sew manufacturing.

- Existing network of factory relationships in China.



Tools to be Used:

- WeChat

- Google Workspace



Non-Negotiables:

- Direct experience working with apparel factories in China.

- Strong understanding of garment construction, manufacturing processes, fabrics, trims, and quality control.

- Experience managing multiple production timelines simultaneously.

- Strong negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

- High attention to detail and strong organizational abilities.

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.



Good luck!

description:

Rootl helps tradespeople and local service businesses get found, picked and booked online. We exist because good businesses lose to worse ones every day. Not because they are worse at the job, but because the worse ones got found first.



It started with advice from an upstairs window to a window cleaner halfway up a ladder. By 2036 we want Rootl to be the UK's most trusted local search company for trades and local service businesses, with our first US hub open.



We are building the team that gets us there. Want a seat on the bus?



## WHAT WE DO



We help tradespeople and local service businesses get found on Google, and inside the AI tools their next customer is already searching with: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini. That is the job. We do it for plumbers, electricians, roofers, joiners, waste firms, architects, developers, and the trades around them. Three core services, one job done properly: getting our clients found when their next customer is looking.



We are a small, growing team. The founder runs sales and strategy. A web developer builds the client sites. A content operations manager runs the content. This new seat is the founder's right hand, the person who holds everything together so the rest of us can do our jobs.



## THE ROLE, IN ONE LINE



You protect the founder's time and turn what is in his head into a system the business can run on.



## ABOUT THIS SEAT



This is the founder's right hand. The person who holds the structure, protects the time, and takes the mental load so the founder can focus on growing the business.



## READ THIS TWICE



The next part is the honest version. Read it carefully, because it tells you exactly what you would be walking into.



## A STRAIGHT WORD, FOUNDER TO YOU



I have never hired someone into this seat before. For two years I have run this business out of my own head. The inbox, the calendar, the onboarding, the follow-ups, the systems, all of it lives in my memory and on my plate. It has got me this far. It will not get me where we are going.



I know that to scale this business I have to get the mentalness out of my head and into a system someone else can run. That is the job. You are not walking into a finished machine. You are helping me build it, then helping me let go of it.



So be clear on what you are walking into. I move fast. I set twelve things going in a week and I need someone to catch the three that fell. Some weeks will feel like organised chaos. This role exists to bring order to it. If that excites you rather than worries you, this is your seat. It is a rocket ship, and I want you on it.



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Here is the real test, and it comes from my corporate days before Rootl. I had an emergency appendectomy three days before a major event in San Diego that I was running. I could not fly. So I wrote up a full handover plan and passed it to my boss from the back of the car while my replacement was on their way to the airport. The event ran without me, because everything they needed was written down.



That is what winning looks like in this seat. If I take an afternoon off, or a week off, the system runs itself. You are the person who makes that true, by turning what is in my head into something written down that anyone can pick up.



There is a second, quieter version of success, and it happens every single day. You become the gateway. I have taken
 off my phone and handed the inbox to you. You manage my calendar, not me. I do not always know what is coming up next week, because I do not need to. You do. I trust the surface you show me to be right, and that trust is the whole point of the seat.



## TRUST AND CONFIDENTIALITY



This is the part that matters most, so read it carefully. This seat sees things almost no one else does. My inbox, my calendar, the numbers, the decisions, the conversations I would not have anywhere else. The role only works on a foundation of complete trust.



We need someone with a high degree of integrity, discretion, and confidentiality. What you see in this seat stays in this seat. This is written into the contract as the first clause, and we will talk about it openly at interview, because it is not a detail. It is the ground the whole role stands on.



## WHY YOU'D WANT THIS SEAT



- A real seat at the table. You work closely with the founder, you are the eyes and ears across the team, and you are someone I can bat ideas off. This is not a fetch-and-carry role.

- A clear lane that is yours. I run sales, marketing and strategy. Our web developer builds the sites. Our content manager runs the content engine. You hold the operation together and protect my time. Everyone knows their seat, and this one is yours.

- Responsibility from day one. Not a six-month shadow.

- You help write the process, not just follow it. Using the founder's own recordings (camcorder method), voice notes, and you build the SOPs every future Rootl hire is trained on.

- Variety with depth. You will do a range of things, and you will also do similar things well and make them tighter each time.

- Real long-term upside for the person who stays the course. We will talk that through properly once you are established.

- The local search world is shifting under everyone's feet right now. You will be close to the front of it.

- We hire the right person, not the perfect person. Every candidate is DISC profiled, because the seat has to fit how we work.



## WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Inbox and calendar. You filter the inbox, surface only what I need, and protect my diary. I do not want
 on my phone. That is your world.

- Helping me plan the week. What is scheduled, what can be pushed, what matters most. You are the person I benchmark against so I feel organised.

- Meeting prep and follow-ups. Getting me ready before a call, and making sure nothing drops after it.

- Marketing and offers admin. Organising campaigns, drafting offers from my rough notes, and crafting my weekly Thursday networking pitch with other business owners so I can review and rehearse it.

- Client onboarding, owned end to end. Intake form, welcome
, CRM setup, contract back-end, getting people access to systems. One repeatable process, run the same way every time.

- Sales support. Scheduling the inbound enquiries and DMs that come from our campaigns, running first-pass research on a prospect against our fit benchmark and handing me a profile sheet before the call, and chasing proposals through to a yes or a clean no.

- Team conduit. Keeping Slack current and Notion up to date, documenting decisions as they happen, and holding our weekly team rhythm with the rest of the team.

- System building. Working with me to document one process every week, so the business stops living in my head.

- Tool stand-up. Owning the setup when a new system comes in: project boards, pipelines, trackers, CRM updates.



There will also be ad hoc tasks. This seat suits someone who enjoys variety and likes being the person who keeps an eye on how things are running across the team.



## HOW THIS SEAT THINKS



This is the standard I am building toward, and it is how I want this seat held from day one. These five run underneath everything above.



- Protect my time. You filter what comes in and d
 what actually needs me. Most things do not. Guarding my time and attention is the first job, and everything else sits under it.

- Prioritise revenue. When everything feels urgent, you sort by what makes money or saves money first. That is the tie-breaker. The task that protects a client or wins a job comes before the one that just shouts loudest.

- Design the play. You come prepared and you think ahead. You see the thing coming before it lands on me, and you have already worked out the options. You plan the week, the meeting, and the follow-up before I have to ask.

- Answer everyone well. Every message gets a clear, kind reply, even when the answer is no. How we treat people is how we are remembered, and you are often the first voice they hear from Rootl.

- Keep the calendar clean and clear. Every entry has the context I need to walk into it cold. Who, what, why, and what I need to have ready. No naked invites, no guessing, no surprises.



## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- You love systems. You see a messy process and you want to make it clean and repeatable.

- You are a strong planner. Detail is your thing. You enjoy mapping out how something will run before it runs.

- You are analytical and you will push back when something does not add up. Not on the person, on the logic. I want someone who tells me when I am wrong.

- You are calm in chaos. A founder still building the rail does not rattle you. You bring order without needing everything to be tidy first.

- You are good with people and relationships. You become the eyes and ears of the team without anyone feeling watched.

- You are comfortable with ambiguity. This seat is being built as it runs, and you are helping to build it.

- You take pride in doing similar work to a high standard, week in, week out, and improving it as you go.

- Excellent written English. We will test this.



Nice to have, not essential:



- A bit of technical appetite. Comfort with tools like Zapier, simple automations, or project planning software.

- Experience supporting a founder or senior leader directly.

- Experience editing AI-written content to a publish-ready standard.

- A handy eye for social content. If you know your way around Canva and can keep a light hand on the quality of social posts going out to local groups, that is a real plus. We have someone producing the content, but having an in-house person who knows the business well enough to sense-check it is genuinely useful.

- A systems-and-time way of thinking. If you have read books like Buy Back Your Time by Dan Martell, The E-Myth by Michael E. Gerber, or you naturally think about how to protect a founder's time and turn chaos into a repeatable system, that is a real plus. It means we already speak the same language.



## HOW THIS SEAT WORKS WITH THE FOUNDER



I run hot and fast. I set a lot in motion and I need someone to hold the structure underneath it. I use the word "comfortable" when I am settling for less than I should, and I say "it's in my head" when I mean I have not written it down yet. I race to the destination before the scaffolding exists, which is sometimes my greatest strength and sometimes my biggest risk.



Your job is the pause valve, not the brake. You do not slow me down. You make sure the path exists for me to run on. Come to me with goals and a plan, never empty-handed. Hit your deadlines. Hold closure on decisions, because leaving things hanging is the thing I find hardest. I am direct, I am honest, and I will tell you what is on my mind. I am looking for someone who can do the same.



## TOOLS YOU WILL USE



Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, HighLevel, Toggl, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. I am already teaching AI to write in my voice, so you will be editing and shaping output, not starting from a blank page. Experience with Zapier and automation tools are a bonus. Training and SOPs provided. You do not need every tool on day one, but you do need to learn fast.



## HOURS, PAY AND HOW IT WORKS



- Part-time to start, around 10 hours a week, paid at $10 USD an hour. Hours grow toward 20 a week within the first 90 days as we find our rhythm and as I hand more over.

- We start with a short unpaid test task so we can see how you work. If it goes well, you move onto a paid trial, paid for the hours you actually work.

- Your hours and your rate both grow as you prove yourself and as the business grows. The aim is to build this into a senior, long-term seat for the right person.

- If the work ever drops, we give you at least one week's written notice of any change to your hours.

- Paid weekly for your first month, then monthly after that, by Wise.

- You track your time in Toggl. Your tracked hours are what you invoice, so it stays clear and fair on both sides.

- Every Monday we run a 30-minute tea
eting using the LIONS sheet: last week, issues, opportunities, the next seven days, and successes. You fill yours in and come ready to run your part.

- Most mornings we jump on a quick 15-minute call to set up the day, what matters, what is moving, what I need from you. A slightly longer one at the start of the week to plan it out. This daily contact is how the seat works, so you need to be someone who is happy with that rhythm.

- I try to work UK hours, 7:00 to 4:30. At least half your hours each week need to fall inside that window so we can work together properly. For you in the Philippines that is roughly 2pm to 11:30pm, so an evening pattern fits well.

- This is an independent contractor role on a proper written agreement covering confidentiality, client data, and how we pay you. You look after your own taxes in the Philippines, and you provide your own computer, reliable internet, and a quiet place to work.

- Four weeks' notice on either side if it is ever not working out.



## THE HIRING PROCESS



We want this to be clear and fair, so here is exactly how it runs. Everything up to the offer is unpaid, and the test task is the same for everyone.



1. You apply (opening with the screening phrase below).

2. We shortlist.

3. We send you a short test task with a clear deadline.

4. You complete and return it.

5. We score it and shortlist again.

6. You complete a DISC profile (a short questionnaire, so we understand how you work).

7. You have an interview with the founder.

8. If it is a yes on both sides, we make a provisional offer: a paid trial of one to two weeks, paid for the hours you work.

9. If the trial goes well, we move into a longer arrangement.



## HOW TO APPLY



- Start your application with the phrase "Save me a seat" so we know you have read this far.

- Tell us, in a few lines, about a time you took something chaotic off someone's plate and made it run smoothly.

- Tell us about a system or process you built or improved, and what changed because of it.

- Share any examples of executive support, admin, or operations work you are proud of.

- The test task, when it comes, will be a real early-morning brain dump from the founder, for you to sort, prioritise, and turn into a clear plan. Unpaid, and the same for everyone.



## A LAST WORD



We are not the biggest name out there, and we are not trying to be, (yet!) We are building something properly, and this seat is fundamental to getting it right. If you have read this far and something here lit you up, that is a good sign. Show us why it should be you.



Want a seat on the bus?

title: Phone Support Executive Assistant/Leasing Agent (WFH)

If you take pride in ownership, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to become an indispensable part of a growing business, keep reading.

-You understand that being the first voice someone hears can directly impact a company's success.

If you genuinely enjoy talking with people, taking ownership, enjoy the feeling of being truly valued and making a difference, plus want a long term stable position, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Fraud Auditor
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical KYC Auditor to join our team. This is a full-time remote position focused on reviewing and verifying various types of documents to ensure they are authentic and meet our compliance standards.

As a KYC Auditor, you will examine documents such as identification records, bank statements, utility bills, and other supporting files. Your role is to carefully analyze these documents, identify any inconsistencies or red flags, and provide clear reasoning for your conclusions. Accuracy and thoroughness are extremely important because mistakes or missed issues can create serious compliance risks.

This is a high-trust role that requires strong attention to detail and the ability to think critically when reviewing information. We are not looking for someone who simply checks boxes. We need someone who can carefully examine documents, spot subtle issues, and explain their findings clearly.

Key Responsibilities:



Review and analyze various types of client documents including IDs, bank statements, utility bills, and other supporting records.

Identify inconsistencies, discrepancies, or potential signs of document alteration.

Provide clear and well-reasoned assessments on whether documents appear genuine or suspicious.

Maintain accurate records of reviews and findings.

Follow established processes while also suggesting improvements when better approaches are identified.

Communicate findings effectively when further clarification or escalation is needed.



Requirements:



Strong attention to detail and a careful, analytical mindset.

Good written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain reasoning clearly.

Ability to work independently and manage your own time effectively.

Comfortable reviewing documents and working with digital files on a daily basis.

Previous experience in KYC, compliance, document review, or auditing is a plus but not required.

Must be reliable, consistent, and serious about producing high-quality work.



We are looking to hire someone for the long term who can grow with the role. In the past, we found that our hiring process was not strict enough, which led to bringing on people who were not suited for this type of detailed and careful work. We are now being much more selective.

Our application process includes a document review assessment to better understand how candidates analyze information and spot issues. We strongly discourage the use of AI tools to complete the assessment. Generic or low-effort responses are easy to identify and will result in disqualification.

If you are someone who takes pride in being thorough, enjoys analyzing details, and is looking for a long-term remote role where careful and accurate work actually matters, we encourage you to apply.



How to Apply:

Please apply through the link below and complete the full application process, including the assessment. Only serious candidates who are willing to put in genuine effort will be considered.

description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage job searching and applications for two professionals based in Australia.



This is a long-term role with flexible hours and the potential to increase over time if you're a great fit.



Responsibilities Search for suitable remote jobs on LinkedIn, SEEK, Indeed and company career pages. Identify roles that match our criteria. Complete and submit job applications on our behalf. Tailor resumes and cover letters using templates and AI tools (training provided). Keep a detailed spreadsheet of all applications. Track application status and follow-up dates. Monitor
s for interview invitations and important updates. Schedule interviews into our calendars when required. Suggest new companies or opportunities we may have missed. About Us 



We are an Australian couple planning an international move over the next year. title: Sales Operations Project Manager
description:
We’re looking for a strong, proactive Sales Operations Project Manager who can lead a sales pod, drive accountability across closers and setters, and maintain seamless communication between Sales, Growth Ops, and Tech Ops.



This is a leadership and coordination role — you are the operational backbone that ensures the pod performs at a high level, SOPs are followed, data is accurate, and every tea
mber stays aligned and supported. If you’re the kind of person who naturally takes ownership, thrives in fast-paced environments, and knows how to communicate with clarity and authority, you’ll excel here.



This is a full-time position, requiring consistent availability from 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, with solid internet, power, and backup.



All applicants must complete DISC and IQ assessments before applying.



Detailed Job Description Breakdown



Pod Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and manage the daily workflow of closers and setters to ensure the sales pod operates smoothly.

• Run daily huddles, weekly check-ins, and pipeline reviews with clear agendas and follow-through.

• Manage pod-level projects (e.g., SOP rollouts, funnel changes, tracking fixes) end-to-end, ensuring on-time execution.

• Monitor pod performance, identify bottlenecks early, and escalate issues with solutions—not problems.

• Own the onboarding and offboarding process for new sales staff, including systems access, SOP orientation, and performance expectations.

• Ensure all pod members maintain clean calendars, proper availability, and updated CRM/task workflows.



Quality Assurance, Accountability & Compliance

• Hold closers and setters accountable for submitting accurate EODs, updating dispositions, and following SOPs consistently.

• Conduct quality checks on sales calls, calendar availability, CRM hygiene, and follow-up sequences.

• Audit all sales data regularly (bookings, show rates, sales, payments, renewals) to ensure accuracy before reporting.

• Flag performance gaps early and coach tea
mbers with clarity, empathy, and firmness.

• Ensure all pod documentation, scorecards, and checklists are consistently maintained and up to date.



Cross-Department Coordination

• Work directly with Front-End Tech Ops, Back-End Automation Specialists, and Growth Ops to resolve tech issues, data discrepancies, or workflow breakdowns.

• Communicate updates clearly and quickly across all stakeholders — closers, setters, Growth Ops, SOMs, Tech Ops, and leadership.

• Serve as the bridge for multi-team projects (automation fixes, tracking repairs, new funnels, offer migrations).

• Maintain a strong working relationship with salespeople (who may be impatient or stressed under pressure) while keeping communication tight, professional, and steady.



Reporting & Performance Management

• Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for leadership, ensuring all numbers are accurate and validated.

• Track KPIs across the full funnel: leads ? setters ? calls ? sales ? renewals.

• Support leadership in evaluating pod performance, identifying improvement plans, and implementing corrective action.

• Ensure the sales pod meets revenue, activity, and quality targets consistently.



Skills & Qualifications

• Project Management experience is mandatory.

(Comfortable managing timelines, action items, dependencies, and follow-through across multiple teams.)

• At least 1–2 years experience in sales operations, sales admin, sales coordination, or a similar leadership/ops role.

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills — able to hold people accountable with firmness and empathy.

• Excellent verbal and written communication; comfortable leading huddles, giving feedback, and jumping on calls.

• Highly organized, detail-driven, and able to manage multiple moving parts in a fast-paced environment.

• Tech-savvy and comfortable navigating CRM, calendar tools, funnels, spreadsheets, and SOPs.

• Experience working with sales teams (closers/setters) is strongly preferred.

• Solution-oriented, proactive, and able to anticipate problems before they happen.

• Thrives in an environment where communication, speed, and ownership are non-negotiable.



If this sounds like you…



If you love driving clarity, supporting high-performance teams, and being the operational heartbeat of a fast-moving sales pod, we’d love to meet you. This role is perfect for someone who wants to grow into higher-level ops leadership while playing a mission-critical role in our sales organization.



About Sales Possible



At Sales Possible, we partner with mission-driven online coaching companies to build world-class marketing and sales ecosystems. We’re not just a sales team provider — we architect full-funnel systems, optimize performance, and support our clients with cutting-edge automation, AI, and operations infrastructure.



We work with high-growth education brands and expert coaches, helping them scale sustainably while delivering exceptional customer experiences.



We’re a fast-moving, tight-knit team that values ownership, proactive communication, and continuous improvement. If you want to work in an environment obsessed with growth, clarity, and performance — you’ll feel right at home here.

You will own all of TurnKey’s digital marketing output. That means every listing launch, every auction campaign, every

This role covers two content streams running simultaneously. First, listing and auction marketing. Second, brand and non-listing content: the monthly content calendar across

Qualifications

• With hands-on digital marketing experience, with at least 1 year managing paid social media advertising campaigns independently — not assisting, owning.

• Proven experience managing Meta Ads Manager campaigns end-to-end: campaign setup, audience targeting, Housing Special Ad Category compliance, budget management, A/B testing, and performance optimization. housing violations are not recoverable mistakes in real estate.

• Demonstrated experience with
 marketing platforms — Mailjet, Flodesk, or equivalent. You can segment a list, build a sequence, schedule a campaign, and diagnose a deliverability problem.

• Strong Canva proficiency. You produce professional-quality real estate marketing graphics — listing announcements, open house posts, auction countdown graphics, Pending and Just Sold assets — without needing design direction on every piece.

• Video editing experience in CapCut or equivalent. You can produce short-form property walkthrough videos and social media Reels ready to post.

• Active, working knowledge of
 and Instagram business page management: publishing, boosting, community management, and brand voice consistency.

description:
WHO WE ARE



Family-owned NJ real estate brokerage with a 20+ year track record managing a portfolio of rental properties. Two principals. You'd be our first dedicated property management hire — direct access to decision-makers, no bureaucracy. We use Notion, OpenPhone, GoHighLevel, and Baselane daily. We also use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and expect you to as well.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Rent collection follow-ups (Baselane + OpenPhone)

- Maintenance request triage and vendor coordination (Notion)

- Lease expiration tracking and renewal prep

- Tenant communication using templates and AI-assisted drafting

- Property and tenant records in Notion

- Daily shift report: what you did, what's pending, what needs my decision





GROWTH PATH (Months 3-6)



- Rental listing coordination (MLS, showings, tenant screening)

- Landlord communication and relationship management

- Transaction coordination support

- SOP creation and process improvement — we want you to make our systems better, not just follow them





REQUIREMENTS (Non-Negotiable)



- 2+ years hands-on US property management experience — managing or directly supporting a real rental portfolio. If your PM experience is limited to data entry or virtual reception, this is not the right fit.

- Actively using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) in your daily work

- Proactive problem-solver who flags issues before they become emergencies

- Built or improved SOPs at a previous job (we'll ask for specifics)

- Works independently — you don't wait to be told what to do

- Takes ownership. When something falls through the cracks, you catch it.

- If you're looking for a role where someone tells you exactly what to do every day, this is not it.





NICE TO HAVE



- NJ/NY rental market knowledge

- Used at least 2 of: Notion, GoHighLevel, OpenPhone, Baselane, AppFolio, Buildium, Rent Manager

- Experience with rent collection platforms

- Familiarity with MLS systems

- Experience building process documentation in Notion

- Background in real estate transaction coordination

- Vendor management experience





SCHEDULE



- Starting with a 1-week paid trial at 1 hour/day

- 5-7 days/week after trial period

- Available time slots (choose one): 9-10 AM, 10-11 AM, 2-3 PM, 3-4 PM, or 4-5 PM Eastern Time

- This is 1 focused, productive hour. We measure output, not time.

- Hours grow based on performance — more work available for the right person





COMPENSATION



- $8/hr starting, clear path to $10+/hr based on performance

- Hours increase as you prove yourself — this can grow to 2-4 hrs/day

- As your role grows: 13th month bonus, health stipend, internet allowance, course funding, paid PH holidays



Long-term role, not a project. Real path from PM operations to managing our entire rental division.





MANAGEMENT STYLE



I'm direct. Sometimes blunt. I value honesty over harmony. I'd rather hear "I don't understand" than discover a mistake later. After 2 weeks of onboarding, my daily involvement is about 15 minutes — the rest is yours to own.





HOW TO APPLY



Include "NJ-PM Ready" as the first line of your message. Then answer these 3 questions:



1. How many rental units have you managed or supported? What PM tools did you use? How long were you in that role?

2. Describe one process you improved at a previous job without being asked. What was the problem, what did you do, what was the result?

3. How do you use AI (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your current work? Tell me a specific workflow, not just "I've used it."



BONUS (Optional but strongly preferred): Record a 2-minute Loom video answering the 3 questions above instead of writing them out. This is not required, but candidates who submit a video will be reviewed first.





Applications without "NJ-PM Ready" and answers to all 3 questions will not be reviewed.

title: Website Designer
description:
About Us

The Oracle Legal Group is a forward-thinking, high-authority law firm. We break away from traditional, stuffy legal branding by combining a sleek, high-end visual aesthetic with bold, impactful messaging. We are looking for a talented Website Designer/Developer who can elevate our digital presence, optimize our user journeys, and ensure our web infrastructure operates at peak performance.



The Role

We are seeking a rare hybrid talent: a creative designer with a sharp eye for modern layout and UX, who also possesses the technical skills to build, maintain, and optimize websites. You will be responsible for refreshing existing brand assets, developing new web experiences, and maintaining the backend health of our digital ecosystem.



Key Responsibilities

Web Design & UX/UI: Craft high-converting, visually stunning web pages that align with our specific brand identity (clean, modern, high-contrast, and sophisticated layouts).



Front-End Development: Bring designs to life ensuring full mobile responsiveness, clean code, and lightning-fast load times.



Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Optimize landing pages and user flows to seamlessly turn website visitors into qualified legal leads.



Technical SEO & Site Health: Partner with our marketing team to implement strict on-page SEO best practices, manage tracking scripts, and resolve technical site errors.



Maintenance & Security: Perform regular site audits, manage plugin updates, secure backups, and troubleshoot hosting/domain issues swiftly.



Requirements & Qualifications

Portfolio Required: A strong portfolio demonstrating modern web design, seamless user flows, and functional development projects.



Platform Expertise: Proven experience building and managing sites on WordPress (or other major CMS platforms used in professional services).



Technical Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and familiar with integrating tracking pixels, Google Analytics, and lead-capture forms.



SEO Savvy: Solid understanding of technical SEO elements (site architecture, Core Web Vitals, schema markup).



Eye for Detail: An aesthetic sensibility that favors minimalist, high-authority corporate designs over generic templates.



Communication: Strong collaboration skills to align with our internal marketing operations and pivot quickly based on performance data.



Why Work With Us?

Creative Autonomy: We value bold ideas and distinct branding. You won’t be building boring templates here.



Streamlined Operations: Work alongside a highly organized internal team that respects your time and provides clear, actionable project scopes.



Growth Potential: Successful project completion can easily lead to a long-term monthly maintenance and development retainer.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume, a brief intro about your experience, and a link to your portfolio showing your best web design and development work.

title: Short-form video editor for ongoing Reels & TikToks — long-term, one creator
description:
LOOKING FOR A SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR TO GROW 

WITH — LONG-TERM, ONE PERSON (NOT AN AGENCY)



Hi! I'm Meadhbh 
 — an integrative somatic practitioner. I create content on nervous system regulation, parts work (IFS-informed), somatic healing, and authentic alignment for high-functioning, highly sensitive women who are done performing and ready to come home to themselves.



I'm scaling up and looking for one editor to work with me directly, long-term — someone who learns my visual world, grows with the account, and becomes my go-to person (not a rotating team/an agency).



What you'd be editing:

- Short-form: Reels — primarily talking head, some collage/voiceover and b-roll

- Roughly 5 videos per week



My style:

I care about the details — fonts, colour, pacing, sound design, and the way things move on screen. Specifically, I love:

- Sound effects, key text/copy pop-ups, icons, and subtle zooms that follow hand gestures and emphasis

- Captions that appear one word at a time, with small white space/pauses cut between words where it sounds right

- Relevant inserted clips or references woven in where it adds to the story

- Engaging opens — sometimes a green-screen backdrop, sometimes extra imagery at the start to hook attention

- Tasteful use of emojis and cute icons (like gold stars) for warmth, never overdone



I'm sending over a full visual reference file so you can see exactly the tone, pacing, and energy I'm going for. I'm not after templated or AI auto-edited content — I want a real point of view that fits the soul of this work.



How we'd work together:

- Batch filming, then building content out together

- Briefs, references, and footage organised in Notion (tags, timestamps, mentions)

- Fast, casual feedback over WhatsApp

- Paid day rate of  $250–400 depending on experience and portfolio. We'll agree your rate together after the test edit, based on turnaround speed and skill shown. No "one round of edits" packages. I want this to feel collaborative, not transactional.



You're a great fit if you:

- Have a portfolio with a clear, distinctive visual style (send me 2–3 of your best)

- Are reliable, communicative, fluent in English (reading/writing/listening) and devoted to deadlines

- Take pride in the craft and have opinions on what makes a video land

- Bonus: any familiarity with wellness, somatic, or trauma-informed content — though not essential if your editing instincts are strong



To apply, send:

1. Your portfolio/showreel

2. A line on the kind of content and style you love editing



Next step: I'll shortlist a few people for a short, paid test edit (talking head or b-roll with voiceover) so we can both see if it's a fit.
